Across five challenging benchmarks, our 3B model outperforms state-of-the-art methods, and plug-in experiments yield an additional average improvement of $\mathbf{12.1\%}$ across different MLLMs.
papers.headline: 小規模AIでも漫画の文脈やユーモアを正確に読み解ける
papers.one_liner: 記号表現や物語の前後関係が複雑な漫画を、30億パラメータ程度の小規模な画像・テキスト統合AI（マルチモーダルモデル）で正確に理解する手法です。推論の道筋（CoT）を整理し、強化学習（報酬ベースの追加学習）を組み合わせることで、AIの思い込み（ハルシネーション）を抑えた論理的な回答が可能になります。
key_points: 漫画特有の「漫符（汗や怒りマーク）」などの抽象的な記号の意味を正しく解釈できる
コマ割りの順番やストーリーの流れを考慮した、高度な「物語の推論」が可能になる
30億パラメータ級の軽量モデルでも、巨大なAIを上回る精度を安価に実現できる
推論のステップを構造化することで、AIがデタラメな理由をこじつける現象を12%以上改善できる
風刺画やネットミームなど、画像と言葉の「裏読み」が必要な複雑なタスクにも応用できる
tags: 画像・テキスト横断理解
who_should_read: PM/プロダクトマネージャー
application_ideas: 工事現場の安全教育マンガやイラストを解析し、危険な状況の解説やクイズを自動生成して教育を効率化する
図面や技術資料の中にある、矢印や特殊なマーク（漫符に似た記号的表現）が示す意図を、周囲の状況から正しく判断する図面認識の精度向上
工場のイラスト付き作業手順書をAIに読み解かせ、作業工程の前後関係に矛盾がないか、論理的なチェックを行う自動校閲システム

papers.title: TiMem: Temporal-Hierarchical Memory Consolidation for Long-Horizon Conversational Agents
papers.abstract: Long-horizon conversational agents have to manage ever-growing interaction histories that quickly exceed the finite context windows of large language models (LLMs). Existing memory frameworks provide limited support for temporally structured information across hierarchical levels, often leading to fragmented memories and unstable long-horizon personalization. We present TiMem, a temporal--hierarchical memory framework that organizes conversations through a Temporal Memory Tree (TMT), enabling systematic memory consolidation from raw conversational observations to progressively abstracted persona representations. TiMem is characterized by three core properties: (1) temporal--hierarchical organization through TMT; (2) semantic-guided consolidation that enables memory integration across hierarchical levels without fine-tuning; and (3) complexity-aware memory recall that balances precision and efficiency across queries of varying complexity. Under a consistent evaluation setup, TiMem achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on both benchmarks, reaching 75.30% on LoCoMo and 76.88% on LongMemEval-S. It outperforms all evaluated baselines while reducing the recalled memory length by 52.20% on LoCoMo. Manifold analysis indicates clear persona separation on LoCoMo and reduced dispersion on LongMemEval-S. Overall, TiMem treats temporal continuity as a first-class organizing principle for long-horizon memory in conversational agents.
papers.headline: AIが長期間のやり取りを忘れず、文脈を完璧に把握し続けられる
papers.one_liner: AIが膨大な過去の対話を「時間の木（Temporal Memory Tree）」構造で整理・要約することで、数ヶ月前の経緯や相手の個性を正確に把握し続ける技術です。自社データでの追加学習（ファインチューニング）なしで、効率的に記憶を整理・呼び出しできます。
key_points: 数ヶ月にわたる長期プロジェクトの全経緯を、AIが正確に記憶し続けられるようになる
膨大な情報を要約して整理するため、AIに読み込ませる文字数を50%以上削減し、コストを抑えられる
「誰がいつ何を言ったか」という事実だけでなく、全体の「背景」や「役割」まで階層的に理解できる
AIの思い込み（ハルシネーション）を抑え、過去の記録に基づいた正確な回答が可能になる
質問の複雑さに応じて、詳細な記憶を掘り返すか要約で済ませるかをAIが賢く判断し、素早く回答する
who_should_read: PM/プロダクトマネージャー
application_ideas: 【インフラ点検】数年前の点検記録や修繕の経緯をAIに記憶させ、今回の異常が「経年劣化か、以前の補修箇所か」を即座に判断するアドバイザーとして活用し、判断ミスを防ぐ。
【BIM/CIM連携】設計変更の膨大なやり取り（いつ、なぜ、誰が変更したか）をAIが記憶し、プロジェクト後半のチェック時に「過去の合意事項と矛盾していないか」を自動で照合する。
【工場の品質検査】過去数年分の不具合事例と対策の経緯をAIに学習させ、現場でトラブルが起きた際に「5年前の類似ケースではこう解決した」とベテラン職員のように即答させる。

papers.title: STReasoner: Empowering LLMs for Spatio-Temporal Reasoning in Time Series via Spatial-Aware Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Spatio-temporal reasoning in time series involves the explicit synthesis of temporal dynamics, spatial dependencies, and textual context. This capability is vital for high-stakes decision-making in systems such as traffic networks, power grids, and disease propagation. However, the field remains underdeveloped because most existing works prioritize predictive accuracy over reasoning. To address the gap, we introduce ST-Bench, a benchmark consisting of four core tasks, including etiological reasoning, entity identification, correlation reasoning, and in-context forecasting, developed via a network SDE-based multi-agent data synthesis pipeline. We then propose STReasoner, which empowers LLM to integrate time series, graph structure, and text for explicit reasoning. To promote spatially grounded logic, we introduce S-GRPO, a reinforcement learning algorithm that rewards performance gains specifically attributable to spatial information. Experiments show that STReasoner achieves average accuracy gains between 17% and 135% at only 0.004X the cost of proprietary models and generalizes robustly to real-world data.
papers.headline: 場所同士の影響をAIが理解し、予測の理由まで説明できる
papers.one_liner: 交通網や電力網のような「場所のつながり」と「時間の変化」を、AIが言葉で説明しながら予測できるようになります。空間情報（グラフ構造）を重視して学習させる手法により、高価なAIの数百分の一のコストで高い精度を実現しました。
key_points: 交通渋滞や感染症などの「なぜここで起きたか？」という背景理由をAIが言葉で説明できる
地図上の位置関係を正しく理解し、遠くの地点で起きた変化がどう影響するかを推論できる
過去の数値データとネットワーク構造を組み合わせて、精度の高い将来予測ができる
巨大な最新AIを使うより圧倒的に低コスト（約250分の1）で、同等以上の性能を発揮できる
学習データにない未知の場所や状況でも、空間のつながりから論理的に判断できる
who_should_read: PM/プロダクトマネージャー
application_ideas: インフラ点検：橋梁やトンネルのセンサーにおいて、一箇所の異常が周囲の構造にどう波及するかをAIが論理的に説明し、優先補修箇所を提案する。
工場の生産管理：各工程の稼働状況と設備配置の相関をAIが学習し、特定ラインの遅延が工場全体に及ぼす影響を予測して対策を提示する。
都市開発・BIM：ビル内の人流データとフロア構成を組み合わせ、混雑の発生理由を「通路の配置と時間帯の影響」として言語化し、設計変更の根拠にする。

papers.title: SYNAPSE: Empowering LLM Agents with Episodic-Semantic Memory via Spreading Activation
papers.abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) excel at generalized reasoning, standard retrieval-augmented approaches fail to address the disconnected nature of long-term agentic memory. To bridge this gap, we introduce Synapse (Synergistic Associative Processing Semantic Encoding), a unified memory architecture that transcends static vector similarity. Drawing from cognitive science, Synapse models memory as a dynamic graph where relevance emerges from spreading activation rather than pre-computed links. By integrating lateral inhibition and temporal decay, the system dynamically highlights relevant sub-graphs while filtering interference. We implement a Triple Hybrid Retrieval strategy that fuses geometric embeddings with activation-based graph traversal. Comprehensive evaluations on the LoCoMo benchmark show that Synapse significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in complex temporal and multi-hop reasoning tasks, offering a robust solution to the "Contextual Tunneling" problem. Our code and data will be made publicly available upon acceptance.
papers.headline: 過去の情報を「点」ではなく「線」で繋いで思い出せる
papers.one_liner: AIが人間の脳のように情報を網目状に繋いで保持し、関連する記憶を連鎖的に引き出す仕組み（拡散的活性化）により、断片的な記録から複雑な背景を読み解けるようになります。
key_points: 数年前の些細な記録も、現在の状況と関連があれば「点と点」を結びつけて思い出せる
膨大なデータの中から、ノイズを省いて「今本当に必要な情報」だけを賢く絞り込める
複数の資料や時期をまたぐような、複雑な「Aが起きたからBになり、結果Cが必要」という推論が得意になる
時間の経過とともに情報の重要度を自動調整し、古い情報と最新情報を適切に使い分けられる
単なるキーワード検索では見つからない、文脈の奥深くに隠れたヒントを見つけ出せる
tags: ナレッジマネジメント
who_should_read: PM/プロダクトマネージャー
application_ideas: 【インフラ点検】10年前の補修記録、昨年の点検写真、現在の異常音を「一連の劣化プロセス」として繋ぎ合わせ、次に故障する箇所を予測する。
【工場・設備保全】機械の異音に対し、過去の類似トラブル、熟練工のメモ、メンテナンスマニュアルを統合し、「3年前のあの部品交換が遠因かもしれない」といった高度な原因究明を行う。
【BIM・設計変更】過去の類似プロジェクトで起きた「設計変更が他部位に波及した履歴」を記憶し、今回の変更が建物全体のどこに影響を及ぼすかを網羅的に予測・警告する。

papers.title: PersonaLedger: Generating Realistic Financial Transactions with Persona Conditioned LLMs and Rule Grounded Feedback
papers.abstract: Strict privacy regulations limit access to real transaction data, slowing open research in financial AI. Synthetic data can bridge this gap, but existing generators do not jointly achieve behavioral diversity and logical groundedness. Rule-driven simulators rely on hand-crafted workflows and shallow stochasticity, which miss the richness of human behavior. Learning-based generators such as GANs capture correlations yet often violate hard financial constraints and still require training on private data. We introduce PersonaLedger, a generation engine that uses a large language model conditioned on rich user personas to produce diverse transaction streams, coupled with an expert configurable programmatic engine that maintains correctness. The LLM and engine interact in a closed loop: after each event, the engine updates the user state, enforces financial rules, and returns a context aware "nextprompt" that guides the LLM toward feasible next actions. With this engine, we create a public dataset of 30 million transactions from 23,000 users and a benchmark suite with two tasks, illiquidity classification and identity theft segmentation. PersonaLedger offers a realistic, privacy preserving resource that supports rigorous evaluation of forecasting and anomaly detection models. PersonaLedger offers the community a rich, realistic, and privacy preserving resource -- complete with code, rules, and generation logs -- to accelerate innovation in financial AI and enable rigorous, reproducible evaluation.
papers.headline: 性格設定したAIがリアルな取引を生成し、不正検知の精度を上げる
papers.one_liner: 特定の性格（節約家、浪費家など）を与えられたAIが、金融ルールを守りながら人間らしい架空の取引履歴を自動生成する技術です。個人情報を一切使わずに、本物に近い「合成データ（AIで作った偽データ）」を作成し、不正検知AIの訓練に活用できます。
key_points: 「お金の使い方の癖」まで再現：AIが個別の性格に基づいて行動するため、単なるランダムではない人間味のある多様なデータが作れます。
計算上の矛盾をゼロに：AIの自由な発想（思い込み）に対し、プログラムが「残高以上の支出は不可」といった金融ルールを強制し、データの正確性を保ちます。
機密情報の壁を突破：銀行の個人データを使わずに開発ができるため、法規制やセキュリティ審査を気にせずスピーディにAIを開発・検証できます。
レアな「不正パターン」を量産：ID盗難や支払い不能といった、現実には少ないが重要なシナリオを意図的に発生させ、AIを「特訓」できます。
大規模な評価用データ：3000万件・2万3000人分という巨大な検証環境が用意されており、自社開発のAIの性能を客観的に測定できます。
who_should_read: PM/プロダクトマネージャー
application_ideas: 建設資材の発注管理において、「几帳面な所長」と「ルーズな所長」のペルソナを設定して架空の注文ログを作成し、横領や発注ミスを自動検知するシステムの訓練に使う。
工場の設備稼働ログにおいて、「熟練工」と「新人」の操作癖をAIでシミュレーション生成し、不適切な操作による故障の予兆を検知するモデルを開発する。
インフラ点検報告書の作成において、様々な書き手の癖を再現した架空の報告データを大量生成し、記述漏れや矛盾をチェックするAIの精度評価に活用する。

papers.title: Stable-RAG: Mitigating Retrieval-Permutation-Induced Hallucinations in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has become a key paradigm for reducing factual hallucinations in large language models (LLMs), yet little is known about how the order of retrieved documents affects model behavior. We empirically show that under Top-5 retrieval with the gold document included, LLM answers vary substantially across permutations of the retrieved set, even when the gold document is fixed in the first position. This reveals a previously underexplored sensitivity to retrieval permutations. Although robust RAG methods primarily focus on enhancing LLM robustness to low-quality retrieval and mitigating positional bias to distribute attention fairly over long contexts, neither approach directly addresses permutation sensitivity. In this paper, we propose Stable-RAG, which exploits permutation sensitivity estimation to mitigate permutation-induced hallucinations. Stable-RAG runs the generator under multiple retrieval orders, clusters hidden states, and decodes from a cluster-center representation that captures the dominant reasoning pattern. It then uses these reasoning results to align hallucinated outputs toward the correct answer, encouraging the model to produce consistent and accurate predictions across document permutations. Experiments on three QA datasets show that Stable-RAG significantly improves answer accuracy, reasoning consistency and robust generalization across datasets, retrievers, and input lengths compared with baselines.
papers.headline: 検索順序によるAIの回答のブレを防ぎ、常に正しい情報を引き出す
papers.one_liner: 資料の並び順によってAIが嘘をつく（ハルシネーション）問題を、資料の順序を入れ替えて複数回シミュレーションし、最も一貫性のある「確実な回答」を導き出す技術です。
key_points: 参考資料の並び順が少し変わっただけで、AIが正解を見失うという「順序への弱さ」を解消できる
「正しい資料が1番上にあるのに間違える」といったAI特有の気まぐれなミスを大幅に減らせる
AIの思考プロセス（隠れ状態）を分析し、最も安定した推論結果を自動的に選別できる
検索システムの精度を上げるのではなく、AI側の「読み取りの安定性」を高めるアプローチである
大量の文書や長文の資料を根拠にする際でも、回答の信頼性と一貫性が担保される
who_should_read: PM/プロダクトマネージャー
application_ideas: 【図面・仕様書チェック】膨大な設計ルールや過去の不具合事例を検索する際、資料の提示順序に左右されず、見落としのない不整合チェックを実現する。
【インフラ点検】過去数十年の点検記録をAIに読み込ませて劣化予測を行う際、情報の前後関係によるバイアスを排除し、正確な修繕計画を提案させる。
【現場のQ&Aシステム】施工マニュアルや安全基準を検索して回答するAIにおいて、どの資料が上位にヒットしたかに関わらず、常に一貫した作業手順を回答させる。

papers.title: Mitigating Prompt-Induced Hallucinations in Large Language Models via Structured Reasoning
papers.abstract: To address hallucination issues in large language models (LLMs), this paper proposes a method for mitigating prompt-induced hallucinations. Building on a knowledge distillation chain-style model, we introduce a code module to guide knowledge-graph exploration and incorporate code as part of the chain-of-thought prompt, forming an external knowledge input that provides more accurate and structured information to the model. Based on this design, we develop an improved knowledge distillation chain-style model and leverage it to analyze and constrain the reasoning process of LLMs, thereby improving inference accuracy. We empirically evaluate the proposed approach using GPT-4 and LLaMA-3.3 on multiple public datasets. Experimental results demonstrate that incorporating code modules significantly enhances the model's ability to capture contextual information and effectively mitigates prompt-induced hallucinations. Specifically, HIT@1, HIT@3, and HIT@5 improve by 15.64%, 13.38%, and 13.28%, respectively. Moreover, the proposed method achieves HIT@1, HIT@3, and HIT@5 scores exceeding 95% across several evaluation settings. These results indicate that the proposed approach substantially reduces hallucination behavior while improving the accuracy and verifiability of large language models.
papers.headline: AIの「勝手な思い込み」を激減させ、根拠のある正確な回答を引き出す
papers.one_liner: ユーザーの指示に惑わされてAIが嘘をつく「思い込み（ハルシネーション）」を、プログラムのコードを用いた「論理的な思考手順（構造化推論）」を組み込むことで解消します。外部の確かな知識（ナレッジグラフ）を正確に参照し、検証可能な回答を生成できる仕組みです。
key_points: AIが指示の内容に引きずられて、もっともらしい嘘をついてしまう現象を大幅に抑制できます。
思考の過程に「コード（プログラム）」を介在させることで、推論のステップが論理的に整理されます。
外部のデータベースを自動で探索し、事実に基づいた正確な情報を引用して回答に組み込めます。
回答の根拠が明確になるため、人間がAIの出力をダブルチェックする負担が軽くなります。
GPT-4やLLaMAなどの最新AIにおいて、正解率が最大15%以上向上し、95%を超える精度を達成しました。
知識の検索プロセスが可視化されるため、なぜその回答になったかの説明責任を果たしやすくなります。
who_should_read: PM/プロダクトマネージャー
application_ideas: 「膨大な工事施工管理基準の照会」の場面で、ルールを整理したデータベースをプログラム的に検索する補助ツールとして使えば、ベテランでも見落とす細かい規定の確認ミスが改善できそう。
「BIMモデルの整合性チェック」の場面で、AIに直接判定させるのではなく『チェック手順をコード化して実行させる』仕組みにすることで、AIの勝手な解釈による誤判定が改善できそう。
「設備保全の過去トラブル検索」の場面で、散在する過去の修理記録から『事実のみを論理的に抽出する』構成にすれば、誤った作業手順の提案による事故リスクが改善できそう。

papers.title: Enhancing Multilingual RAG Systems with Debiased Language Preference-Guided Query Fusion
papers.abstract: Multilingual Retrieval-Augmented Generation (mRAG) systems often exhibit a perceived preference for high-resource languages, particularly English, resulting in the widespread adoption of English pivoting. While prior studies attribute this advantage to the superior English-centric capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs), we find that such measurements are significantly distorted by structural priors inherent in evaluation benchmarks. Specifically, we identify exposure bias and a gold availability prior-both driven by the disproportionate concentration of resources in English-as well as cultural priors rooted in topic locality, as factors that hinder accurate assessment of genuine language preference. To address these biases, we propose DeLP (Debiased Language Preference), a calibrated metric designed to explicitly factor out these structural confounds. Our analysis using DeLP reveals that the previously reported English preference is largely a byproduct of evidence distribution rather than an inherent model bias. Instead, we find that retrievers fundamentally favor monolingual alignment between the query and the document language. Building on this insight, we introduce DELTA (DEbiased Language preference-guided Text Augmentation), a lightweight and efficient mRAG framework that strategically leverages monolingual alignment to optimize cross-lingual retrieval and generation. Experimental results demonstrate that DELTA consistently outperforms English pivoting and mRAG baselines across diverse languages.
papers.headline: 多言語での情報検索、翻訳せず「そのまま」探す方が正確になる
papers.one_liner: AIが情報を探す際、無理に英語に翻訳する（英語ピボット）のではなく、資料と同じ言語で検索をかけることで、AIの思い込み（バイアス）を排除し、正確な情報抽出を可能にする技術です。
key_points: 英語を介在させないため、翻訳過程で発生するニュアンスの欠落や誤解を防げます
「英語の方が精度が高い」というAI界の定説が、実はデータの偏りによる錯覚だったことを解明しました
AIが本来得意な「同じ言語同士の照合」を最大化し、母国語のまま高品質な回答が得られます
追加の膨大な学習（ファインチューニング）が不要なため、既存システムに低コストで導入可能です
技術基準書やマニュアルなど、専門用語が多い多国籍プロジェクトでの検索精度が向上します
who_should_read: PM/プロダクトマネージャー
application_ideas: 海外建設プロジェクトにおいて、現地語の法令や技術基準書から、翻訳を通さずに必要な安全規定をピンポイントで検索する機能として活用する。

papers.title: Towards Zero-Shot Point Cloud Registration Across Diverse Scales, Scenes, and Sensor Setups
papers.abstract: Some deep learning-based point cloud registration methods struggle with zero-shot generalization, often requiring dataset-specific hyperparameter tuning or retraining for new environments. We identify three critical limitations: (a) fixed user-defined parameters (e.g., voxel size, search radius) that fail to generalize across varying scales, (b) learned keypoint detectors exhibit poor cross-domain transferability, and (c) absolute coordinates amplify scale mismatches between datasets. To address these three issues, we present BUFFER-X, a training-free registration framework that achieves zero-shot generalization through: (a) geometric bootstrapping for automatic hyperparameter estimation, (b) distribution-aware farthest point sampling to replace learned detectors, and (c) patch-level coordinate normalization to ensure scale consistency. Our approach employs hierarchical multi-scale matching to extract correspondences across local, middle, and global receptive fields, enabling robust registration in diverse environments. For efficiency-critical applications, we introduce BUFFER-X-Lite, which reduces total computation time by 43% (relative to BUFFER-X) through early exit strategies and fast pose solvers while preserving accuracy. We evaluate on a comprehensive benchmark comprising 12 datasets spanning object-scale, indoor, and outdoor scenes, including cross-sensor registration between heterogeneous LiDAR configurations. Results demonstrate that our approach generalizes effectively without manual tuning or prior knowledge of test domains. Code: https://github.com/MIT-SPARK/BUFFER-X.
papers.headline: どんな3D点群でも設定不要で瞬時に位置合わせできる
papers.one_liner: 異なるセンサーや場所で取得した3Dデータ（点群）を、AIの再学習や面倒な設定なしで正確に重ね合わせる技術です。形状の特徴を自動で解析する仕組み（幾何学的ブートストラップ）により、小さな部品から広大な屋外まで幅広く対応します。
key_points: 現場やセンサーが変わるたびに必要だったAIの「再学習」が一切不要になる

papers.title: Multi-RADS Synthetic Radiology Report Dataset and Head-to-Head Benchmarking of 41 Open-Weight and Proprietary Language Models
papers.abstract: Background: Reporting and Data Systems (RADS) standardize radiology risk communication but automated RADS assignment from narrative reports is challenging because of guideline complexity, output-format constraints, and limited benchmarking across RADS frameworks and model sizes. Purpose: To create RXL-RADSet, a radiologist-verified synthetic multi-RADS benchmark, and compare validity and accuracy of open-weight small language models (SLMs) with a proprietary model for RADS assignment. Materials and Methods: RXL-RADSet contains 1,600 synthetic radiology reports across 10 RADS (BI-RADS, CAD-RADS, GB-RADS, LI-RADS, Lung-RADS, NI-RADS, O-RADS, PI-RADS, TI-RADS, VI-RADS) and multiple modalities. Reports were generated by LLMs using scenario plans and simulated radiologist styles and underwent two-stage radiologist verification. We evaluated 41 quantized SLMs (12 families, 0.135-32B parameters) and GPT-5.2 under a fixed guided prompt. Primary endpoints were validity and accuracy; a secondary analysis compared guided versus zero-shot prompting. Results: Under guided prompting GPT-5.2 achieved 99.8% validity and 81.1% accuracy (1,600 predictions). Pooled SLMs (65,600 predictions) achieved 96.8% validity and 61.1% accuracy; top SLMs in the 20-32B range reached ~99% validity and mid-to-high 70% accuracy. Performance scaled with model size (inflection between <1B and >=10B) and declined with RADS complexity primarily due to classification difficulty rather than invalid outputs. Guided prompting improved validity (99.2% vs 96.7%) and accuracy (78.5% vs 69.6%) compared with zero-shot. Conclusion: RXL-RADSet provides a radiologist-verified multi-RADS benchmark; large SLMs (20-32B) can approach proprietary-model performance under guided prompting, but gaps remain for higher-complexity schemes.
papers.headline: 専門医レベルの診断書分類が、安価な小型AIでも可能に
papers.one_liner: 医療の複雑な診断基準（RADS）に基づき、医師の記述をAIが自動分類する技術です。適切な「指示書（ガイド付きプロンプト）」を与えることで、安価な小型AIでも高価な最新AIに近い精度で診断レポートを整理できるようになります。
key_points: 10種類の複雑な医療診断基準を、AIがルール通りに正確に分類できることが証明された

1,600件の専門医検証済みデータにより、AIの「思い込み（でっち上げ）」を厳格に評価可能
複雑なルールに従う必要がある業務において、モデルのサイズよりも「指示の出し方」が重要だと判明

papers.title: Towards Comprehensive Stage-wise Benchmarking of Large Language Models in Fact-Checking
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in real-world fact-checking systems, yet existing evaluations focus predominantly on claim verification and overlook the broader fact-checking workflow, including claim extraction and evidence retrieval. This narrow focus prevents current benchmarks from revealing systematic reasoning failures, factual blind spots, and robustness limitations of modern LLMs. To bridge this gap, we present FactArena, a fully automated arena-style evaluation framework that conducts comprehensive, stage-wise benchmarking of LLMs across the complete fact-checking pipeline. FactArena integrates three key components: (i) an LLM-driven fact-checking process that standardizes claim decomposition, evidence retrieval via tool-augmented interactions, and justification-based verdict prediction; (ii) an arena-styled judgment mechanism guided by consolidated reference guidelines to ensure unbiased and consistent pairwise comparisons across heterogeneous judge agents; and (iii) an arena-driven claim-evolution module that adaptively generates more challenging and semantically controlled claims to probe LLMs' factual robustness beyond fixed seed data. Across 16 state-of-the-art LLMs spanning seven model families, FactArena produces stable and interpretable rankings. Our analyses further reveal significant discrepancies between static claim-verification accuracy and end-to-end fact-checking competence, highlighting the necessity of holistic evaluation. The proposed framework offers a scalable and trustworthy paradigm for diagnosing LLMs' factual reasoning, guiding future model development, and advancing the reliable deployment of LLMs in safety-critical fact-checking applications.
papers.headline: 情報の嘘を突き止めるAIの「実力」を全行程で自動評価できる
papers.one_liner: AIが情報の真偽を確かめる際の「情報の抜き出し」「証拠探し」「最終判断」という一連の流れを、AI同士が競い合う形式（アリーナ方式）で自動採点し、AIの「思い込み（ハルシネーション）」を正確に見抜けるようになります。
key_points: 「情報の抜き出し」から「裏付け調査」まで、実務に近い一連の工程でAIの賢さを判定できる

papers.title: The Path Ahead for Agentic AI: Challenges and Opportunities
papers.abstract: The evolution of Large Language Models (LLMs) from passive text generators to autonomous, goal-driven systems represents a fundamental shift in artificial intelligence. This chapter examines the emergence of agentic AI systems that integrate planning, memory, tool use, and iterative reasoning to operate autonomously in complex environments. We trace the architectural progression from statistical models to transformer-based systems, identifying capabilities that enable agentic behavior: long-range reasoning, contextual awareness, and adaptive decision-making. The chapter provides three contributions: (1) a synthesis of how LLM capabilities extend toward agency through reasoning-action-reflection loops; (2) an integrative framework describing core components perception, memory, planning, and tool execution that bridge LLMs with autonomous behavior; (3) a critical assessment of applications and persistent challenges in safety, alignment, reliability, and sustainability. Unlike existing surveys, we focus on the architectural transition from language understanding to autonomous action, emphasizing the technical gaps that must be resolved before deployment. We identify critical research priorities, including verifiable planning, scalable multi-agent coordination, persistent memory architectures, and governance frameworks. Responsible advancement requires simultaneous progress in technical robustness, interpretability, and ethical safeguards to realize potential while mitigating risks of misalignment and unintended consequences.
papers.headline: AIが自分で考え、道具を使い、仕事を完遂できるようになる
papers.one_liner: AIが単なる「文章作成機」から、自ら計画を立て、過去を記憶し、必要に応じて外部ツールを使いこなす「自律型エージェント」へと進化します。これにより、人間が細かく指示を出さなくても、AIが試行錯誤（自己修正）しながら目標を達成する仕組みが実現します。

papers.title: Hypothesize-Then-Verify: Speculative Root Cause Analysis for Microservices with Pathwise Parallelism
papers.abstract: Microservice systems have become the backbone of cloud-native enterprise applications due to their resource elasticity, loosely coupled architecture, and lightweight deployment. Yet, the intrinsic complexity and dynamic runtime interactions of such systems inevitably give rise to anomalies. Ensuring system reliability therefore hinges on effective root cause analysis (RCA), which entails not only localizing the source of anomalies but also characterizing the underlying failures in a timely and interpretable manner. Recent advances in intelligent RCA techniques, particularly those powered by large language models (LLMs), have demonstrated promising capabilities, as LLMs reduce reliance on handcrafted features while offering cross-platform adaptability, task generalization, and flexibility. However, existing LLM-based methods still suffer from two critical limitations: (a) limited exploration diversity, which undermines accuracy, and (b) heavy dependence on large-scale LLMs, which results in slow inference. To overcome these challenges, we propose SpecRCA, a speculative root cause analysis framework for microservices that adopts a \textit{hypothesize-then-verify} paradigm. SpecRCA first leverages a hypothesis drafting module to rapidly generate candidate root causes, and then employs a parallel root cause verifier to efficiently validate them. Preliminary experiments on the AIOps 2022 dataset demonstrate that SpecRCA achieves superior accuracy and efficiency compared to existing approaches, highlighting its potential as a practical solution for scalable and interpretable RCA in complex microservice environments.
papers.headline: 複雑なシステム故障の「真犯人」をAIが高速に特定する

papers.title: Reducing Hallucinations in LLMs via Factuality-Aware Preference Learning
papers.abstract: Preference alignment methods such as RLHF and Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) improve instruction following, but they can also reinforce hallucinations when preference judgments reward fluency and confidence over factual correctness. We introduce F-DPO (Factuality-aware Direct Preference Optimization), a simple extension of DPO that uses only binary factuality labels. F-DPO (i) applies a label-flipping transformation that corrects misordered preference pairs so the chosen response is never less factual than the rejected one, and (ii) adds a factuality-aware margin that emphasizes pairs with clear correctness differences, while reducing to standard DPO when both responses share the same factuality. We construct factuality-aware preference data by augmenting DPO pairs with binary factuality indicators and synthetic hallucinated variants. Across seven open-weight LLMs (1B-14B), F-DPO consistently improves factuality and reduces hallucination rates relative to both base models and standard DPO. On Qwen3-8B, F-DPO reduces hallucination rates by five times (from 0.424 to 0.084) while improving factuality scores by 50 percent (from 5.26 to 7.90). F-DPO also generalizes to out-of-distribution benchmarks: on TruthfulQA, Qwen2.5-14B achieves plus 17 percent MC1 accuracy (0.500 to 0.585) and plus 49 percent MC2 accuracy (0.357 to 0.531). F-DPO requires no auxiliary reward model, token-level annotations, or multi-stage training.
papers.headline: AIの「もっともらしい嘘」を5分の1に激減させ、正確な回答を実現
papers.one_liner: AIが「自信満々に嘘をつく（ハルシネーション）」原因を学習段階で修正し、事実に基づいた正しい情報を優先して選べるようにする技術です。特別な評価用AIを準備することなく、シンプルに回答の正確性（ファクチュアリティ）を高められます。
key_points: 「知ったかぶり」の発生率を最大で5分の1まで劇的に抑え、情報の信頼性を向上できる

papers.title: MedDialogRubrics: A Comprehensive Benchmark and Evaluation Framework for Multi-turn Medical Consultations in Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Medical conversational AI (AI) plays a pivotal role in the development of safer and more effective medical dialogue systems. However, existing benchmarks and evaluation frameworks for assessing the information-gathering and diagnostic reasoning abilities of medical large language models (LLMs) have not been rigorously evaluated. To address these gaps, we present MedDialogRubrics, a novel benchmark comprising 5,200 synthetically constructed patient cases and over 60,000 fine-grained evaluation rubrics generated by LLMs and subsequently refined by clinical experts, specifically designed to assess the multi-turn diagnostic capabilities of LLM. Our framework employs a multi-agent system to synthesize realistic patient records and chief complaints from underlying disease knowledge without accessing real-world electronic health records, thereby mitigating privacy and data-governance concerns. We design a robust Patient Agent that is limited to a set of atomic medical facts and augmented with a dynamic guidance mechanism that continuously detects and corrects hallucinations throughout the dialogue, ensuring internal coherence and clinical plausibility of the simulated cases. Furthermore, we propose a structured LLM-based and expert-annotated rubric-generation pipeline that retrieves Evidence-Based Medicine (EBM) guidelines and utilizes the reject sampling to derive a prioritized set of rubric items ("must-ask" items) for each case. We perform a comprehensive evaluation of state-of-the-art models and demonstrate that, across multiple assessment dimensions, current models face substantial challenges. Our results indicate that improving medical dialogue will require advances in dialogue management architectures, not just incremental tuning of the base-model.
papers.headline: AIが医師レベルの「聞き取り」と「論理判断」を正しく行えるか採点できる
papers.one_liner: 診察の際、AIが「聞くべきことを聞き」「正しい判断（診断）」ができているかを厳密に評価する仕組みです。AI同士に患者役と医師役を演じさせて、医学的根拠（ガイドライン）に基づいた「必須チェック項目」で自動採点します。
