papers.title: PRECTR-V2:Unified Relevance-CTR Framework with Cross-User Preference Mining, Exposure Bias Correction, and LLM-Distilled Encoder Optimization
papers.abstract: In search systems, effectively coordinating the two core objectives of search relevance matching and click-through rate (CTR) prediction is crucial for discovering users' interests and enhancing platform revenue. In our prior work PRECTR, we proposed a unified framework to integrate these two subtasks,thereby eliminating their inconsistency and leading to mutual benefit.However, our previous work still faces three main challenges. First, low-active users and new users have limited search behavioral data, making it difficult to achieve effective personalized relevance preference modeling. Second, training data for ranking models predominantly come from high-relevance exposures, creating a distribution mismatch with the broader candidate space in coarse-ranking, leading to generalization bias. Third, due to the latency constraint, the original model employs an Emb+MLP architecture with a frozen BERT encoder, which prevents joint optimization and creates misalignment between representation learning and CTR fine-tuning. To solve these issues, we further reinforce our method and propose PRECTR-V2. Specifically, we mitigate the low-activity users' sparse behavior problem by mining global relevance preferences under the specific query, which facilitates effective personalized relevance modeling for cold-start scenarios. Subsequently, we construct hard negative samples through embedding noise injection and relevance label reconstruction, and optimize their relative ranking against positive samples via pairwise loss, thereby correcting exposure bias. Finally, we pretrain a lightweight transformer-based encoder via knowledge distillation from LLM and SFT on the text relevance classification task. This encoder replaces the frozen BERT module, enabling better adaptation to CTR fine-tuning and advancing beyond the traditional Emb+MLP paradigm.
papers.headline: 検索のズレをなくし、好みにぴったりの提案ができるようになる

papers.title: Qwen-BIM: developing large language model for BIM-based design with domain-specific benchmark and dataset
papers.abstract: As the construction industry advances toward digital transformation, BIM (Building Information Modeling)-based design has become a key driver supporting intelligent construction. Despite Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown potential in promoting BIM-based design, the lack of specific datasets and LLM evaluation benchmarks has significantly hindered the performance of LLMs. Therefore, this paper addresses this gap by proposing: 1) an evaluation benchmark for BIM-based design together with corresponding quantitative indicators to evaluate the performance of LLMs, 2) a method for generating textual data from BIM and constructing corresponding BIM-derived datasets for LLM evaluation and fine-tuning, and 3) a fine-tuning strategy to adapt LLMs for BIM-based design. Results demonstrate that the proposed domain-specific benchmark effectively and comprehensively assesses LLM capabilities, highlighting that general LLMs are still incompetent for domain-specific tasks. Meanwhile, with the proposed benchmark and datasets, Qwen-BIM is developed and achieves a 21.0% average increase in G-Eval score compared to the base LLM model. Notably, with only 14B parameters, performance of Qwen-BIM is comparable to that of general LLMs with 671B parameters for BIM-based design tasks. Overall, this study develops the first domain-specific LLM for BIM-based design by introducing a comprehensive benchmark and high-quality dataset, which provide a solid foundation for developing BIM-related LLMs in various fields.
papers.headline: BIMを理解するAIが、複雑な設計業務を劇的に効率化する

papers.title: OptiLeak: Efficient Prompt Reconstruction via Reinforcement Learning in Multi-tenant LLM Services
papers.abstract: Multi-tenant LLM serving frameworks widely adopt shared Key-Value caches to enhance efficiency. However, this creates side-channel vulnerabilities enabling prompt leakage attacks. Prior studies identified these attack surfaces yet focused on expanding attack vectors rather than optimizing attack performance, reporting impractically high attack costs that underestimate the true privacy risk. We propose OptiLeak, a reinforcement learning-enhanced framework that maximizes prompt reconstruction efficiency through two-stage fine-tuning. Our key insight is that domain-specific ``hard tokens'' -- terms difficult to predict yet carrying sensitive information -- can be automatically identified via likelihood ranking and used to construct preference pairs for Direct Preference Optimization, eliminating manual annotation. This enables effective preference alignment while avoiding the overfitting issues of extended supervised fine-tuning. Evaluated on three benchmarks spanning medical and financial domains, OptiLeak achieves up to $12.48\times$ reduction in average requests per token compared to baseline approaches, with consistent improvements across model scales from 3B to 14B parameters. Our findings demonstrate that cache-based prompt leakage poses a more severe threat than previously reported, underscoring the need for robust cache isolation in production deployments.
papers.headline: 共有AIから機密を抜き取る「のぞき見」が従来の12倍容易に
papers.one_liner: 複数の利用者がAIを共有する環境で、他人の入力内容（プロンプト）を極めて少ない試行回数で復元できてしまう手法です。AIが推測しにくい「専門用語」を賢く特定する強化学習（AIの反復学習）を用いることで、従来より格段に低コストで機密情報が漏洩するリスクを明らかにしました。

papers.title: Event-Aided Sharp Radiance Field Reconstruction for Fast-Flying Drones
papers.abstract: Fast-flying aerial robots promise rapid inspection under limited battery constraints, with direct applications in infrastructure inspection, terrain exploration, and search and rescue. However, high speeds lead to severe motion blur in images and induce significant drift and noise in pose estimates, making dense 3D reconstruction with Neural Radiance Fields (NeRFs) particularly challenging due to their high sensitivity to such degradations. In this work, we present a unified framework that leverages asynchronous event streams alongside motion-blurred frames to reconstruct high-fidelity radiance fields from agile drone flights. By embedding event-image fusion into NeRF optimization and jointly refining event-based visual-inertial odometry priors using both event and frame modalities, our method recovers sharp radiance fields and accurate camera trajectories without ground-truth supervision. We validate our approach on both synthetic data and real-world sequences captured by a fast-flying drone. Despite highly dynamic drone flights, where RGB frames are severely degraded by motion blur and pose priors become unreliable, our method reconstructs high-fidelity radiance fields and preserves fine scene details, delivering a performance gain of over 50% on real-world data compared to state-of-the-art methods.
papers.headline: 高速飛行中のドローンから、ブレのない鮮明な3Dマップが作成可能に
papers.one_liner: ドローンが高速で飛ぶとカメラ画像はボケてしまいますが、光の変化を高速で捉える特殊なセンサー（イベントカメラ）を活用することで、ブレを補正し精密な3Dモデル（NeRF：複数の写真から3D空間を再現する技術）を構築できます。
key_points: 高速移動中の撮影で避けられない「画像のボケ」をAIが自動で修正し、クッキリした3D映像を復元できる

papers.title: OCR-Agent: Agentic OCR with Capability and Memory Reflection
papers.abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated significant potential on complex visual understanding tasks through iterative optimization methods.However, these models generally lack effective self-correction mechanisms, making it difficult for them to independently rectify cognitive biases. Consequently, during multi-turn revisions, they often fall into repetitive and ineffective attempts, failing to achieve stable improvements in answer quality.To address this issue, we propose a novel iterative self-correction framework that endows models with two key capabilities: Capability Reflection and Memory Reflection. This framework guides the model to first diagnose errors and generate a correction plan via Capability Reflection, then leverage Memory Reflection to review past attempts to avoid repetition and explore new solutions, and finally, optimize the answer through rigorous re-reasoning. Experiments on the challenging OCRBench v2 benchmark show that OCR-Agent outperforms the current open-source SOTA model InternVL3-8B by +2.0 on English and +1.2 on Chinese subsets, while achieving state-of-the-art results in Visual Understanding (79.9) and Reasoning (66.5) - surpassing even larger fine-tuned models. Our method demonstrates that structured, self-aware reflection can significantly enhance VLMs' reasoning robustness without additional training. Code: https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/OCR-Agent.
papers.headline: AIが自分のミスを分析し、正確に文字を読み直せるようになる

papers.title: ParkDiffusion++: Ego Intention Conditioned Joint Multi-Agent Trajectory Prediction for Automated Parking using Diffusion Models
papers.abstract: Automated parking is a challenging operational domain for advanced driver assistance systems, requiring robust scene understanding and interaction reasoning. The key challenge is twofold: (i) predict multiple plausible ego intentions according to context and (ii) for each intention, predict the joint responses of surrounding agents, enabling effective what-if decision-making. However, existing methods often fall short, typically treating these interdependent problems in isolation. We propose ParkDiffusion++, which jointly learns a multi-modal ego intention predictor and an ego-conditioned multi-agent joint trajectory predictor for automated parking. Our approach makes several key contributions. First, we introduce an ego intention tokenizer that predicts a small set of discrete endpoint intentions from agent histories and vectorized map polylines. Second, we perform ego-intention-conditioned joint prediction, yielding socially consistent predictions of the surrounding agents for each possible ego intention. Third, we employ a lightweight safety-guided denoiser with different constraints to refine joint scenes during training, thus improving accuracy and safety. Fourth, we propose counterfactual knowledge distillation, where an EMA teacher refined by a frozen safety-guided denoiser provides pseudo-targets that capture how agents react to alternative ego intentions. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that ParkDiffusion++ achieves state-of-the-art performance on the Dragon Lake Parking (DLP) dataset and the Intersections Drone (inD) dataset. Importantly, qualitative what-if visualizations show that other agents react appropriately to different ego intentions.
papers.headline: 周りの反応を先読みし、狭い駐車場でもぶつからず自動駐車できる

papers.title: PIME: Prototype-based Interpretable MCTS-Enhanced Brain Network Analysis for Disorder Diagnosis
papers.abstract: Recent deep learning methods for fMRI-based diagnosis have achieved promising accuracy by modeling functional connectivity networks. However, standard approaches often struggle with noisy interactions, and conventional post-hoc attribution methods may lack reliability, potentially highlighting dataset-specific artifacts. To address these challenges, we introduce PIME, an interpretable framework that bridges intrinsic interpretability with minimal-sufficient subgraph optimization by integrating prototype-based classification and consistency training with structural perturbations during learning. This encourages a structured latent space and enables Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) under a prototype-consistent objective to extract compact minimal-sufficient explanatory subgraphs post-training. Experiments on three benchmark fMRI datasets demonstrate that PIME achieves state-of-the-art performance. Furthermore, by constraining the search space via learned prototypes, PIME identifies critical brain regions that are consistent with established neuroimaging findings. Stability analysis shows 90% reproducibility and consistent explanations across atlases.
papers.headline: 複雑なデータから「重要箇所」を根拠付きで特定できるようになる
papers.one_liner: 脳の活動ネットワークから「診断の決め手」となる最小限のパターンを抽出し、AIがどの部分を根拠に判断したかを視覚化する技術です。AI特有の「思い込み」を排除し、100回中90回同じ場所を指摘できるほど高い安定性（再現性）を実現しました。
key_points: 「なんとなく怪しい」ではなく、典型的な異常パターンと照らし合わせた納得感のある説明ができる
複雑に絡み合うデータの中から、判断に不可欠な「最小限の重要ポイント」だけを抜き出せる
データのノイズ（誤差）に強く、分析のたびに結果が変わるというAIの弱点を克服している
専門家が長年の経験で重視してきたポイントとAIの指摘が一致するため、現場で信頼されやすい
将来的な予測だけでなく、現在の状態がなぜ「異常」と言えるのかの証拠を提示できる
who_should_read: PM/プロダクトマネージャー
application_ideas: インフラ点検の場面で、多数のセンサーデータの相関から「劣化の典型パターン」を特定し、補修が必要な根拠を可視化することで、点検員の判断をサポートする。
工場の設備診断において、複雑な振動や音のデータから「故障の予兆となる最小限の特定波形」を抽出することで、誤報の少ない高精度な予兆検知システムを構築する。
BIMモデルの不備チェックにおいて、過去の「典型的な設計ミス」の構造パターンを学習させ、AIが指摘した修正箇所の根拠を設計者に提示することで、合意形成をスムーズにする。

papers.title: ID-LoRA: Efficient Low-Rank Adaptation Inspired by Matrix Interpolative Decomposition
papers.abstract: LoRA has become a universal Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) technique that equips Large Language Models (LLMs) to adapt quickly to new tasks. However, when these models are scaled up, even the latest LoRA variants still introduce considerable overhead in trainable parameters. Conversely, aggressively lowering the rank to curb this overhead markedly degrades performance in complex multi-task settings. We propose ID-LoRA, a novel PEFT framework that breaks the trade-off. Its core innovation lies in extracting and reusing clustered parameter groups from the pretrained weight matrix. These groups are then used to form multiple low-rank components, all of which share only a single initialized trainable low-rank matrix. This approach cuts the number of trainable parameters while keeping the model's capacity intact. We evaluate ID-LoRA on five diverse benchmarks: Mathematical Reasoning, Code Generation, MMLU, CommonsenseQA, and Safety Alignment. ID-LoRA outperforms both full fine-tuning and existing PEFT baselines (e.g., LoRA, DoRA, HydraLoRA) while using up to 46% fewer trainable parameters than the standard LoRA. In multi-task scenarios, it surpasses LoRA and its recent variants (e.g., DoRA and HydraLoRA) on both Code and MMLU tasks, yet requires only 54% of the trainable parameters demanded by the conventional LoRA.
papers.headline: AIの追加学習が、半分以下の負荷でより賢くなる
papers.one_liner: 元のAIが持つ知識のパーツを「再利用」することで、自社データでの追加学習（ファインチューニング）に必要な計算コストを最大46%削減しつつ、複雑な課題もより正確に解けるようにする技術です。
key_points: 学習に必要な計算資源やメモリを最大46%削減でき、低コストでAIを強化できる
従来の手法よりも少ないデータ負荷で、数学的推論やコード生成の性能が向上する
「図面チェック」と「文章作成」など、複数の異なる業務を同時に覚えさせても性能が落ちにくい
元のAIが持っている「知識のパターン」を賢く使い回すため、学習効率が極めて高い
大規模なAIモデルを自社専用にカスタマイズする際の、時間とコストのハードルを大幅に下げる
who_should_read: PM/プロダクトマネージャー
application_ideas: 複雑な「図面チェックルール」の学習：建築基準法や社内規定などの多岐にわたる項目を、低コストでAIに教え込み、見落とし防止の精度を高める。
インフラ点検の「判断基準」の個別最適化：橋梁やトンネルなど、対象物ごとに異なる点検のコツをAIに効率的に学習させ、現場ごとに最適化された点検アシスタントを作成する。
工場内の「複数種類の不具合」検知：傷・汚れ・形状不良など、性質の異なる複数の異常を一つのAIで効率的に学習させ、検知精度と処理速度を両立させる。

papers.title: Efficient and Explainable End-to-End Autonomous Driving via Masked Vision-Language-Action Diffusion
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have emerged as promising candidates for end-to-end autonomous driving. However, these models typically face challenges in inference latency, action precision, and explainability. Existing autoregressive approaches struggle with slow token-by-token generation, while prior diffusion-based planners often rely on verbose, general-purpose language tokens that lack explicit geometric structure. In this work, we propose Masked Vision-Language-Action Diffusion for Autonomous Driving (MVLAD-AD), a novel framework designed to bridge the gap between efficient planning and semantic explainability via a masked vision-language-action diffusion model. Unlike methods that force actions into the language space, we introduce a discrete action tokenization strategy that constructs a compact codebook of kinematically feasible waypoints from real-world driving distributions. Moreover, we propose geometry-aware embedding learning to ensure that embeddings in the latent space approximate physical geometric metrics. Finally, an action-priority decoding strategy is introduced to prioritize trajectory generation. Extensive experiments on nuScenes and derived benchmarks demonstrate that MVLAD-AD achieves superior efficiency and outperforms state-of-the-art autoregressive and diffusion baselines in planning precision, while providing high-fidelity and explainable reasoning.
papers.headline: AIが判断理由を説明しつつ、高速・正確に運転操作を行う
papers.one_liner: 自動運転AIが「なぜその進路を選んだか」という根拠を説明しながら、画像生成AIの仕組み（拡散モデル）を応用して、瞬時に正確な走行ルートを導き出す技術です。
key_points: AIが「なぜ止まったか」「なぜ曲がったか」を言葉で説明できるため、ブラックボックス化を防ぎ、安全性の確認がしやすくなる
一文字ずつ計算する従来のAIと違い、進路全体を一気に予測するため、刻々と変わる状況下でも判断の遅れ（タイムラグ）が少ない
実際の道路で「物理的に曲がれるか」を考慮したコードブック（動きの辞書）を使うため、非現実的な急カーブなどのミスを防げる
空間の広さや距離感を正確に把握する学習アルゴリズムにより、障害物との接触リスクを最小限に抑えた走行計画を立てられる
最も重要な「運転操作」の計算を優先する仕組みにより、限られた処理能力でも高い精度で目的地まで誘導できる
who_should_read: PM/プロダクトマネージャー
application_ideas: 工場の自動搬送ロボット（AGV）において、停止した際に「荷崩れの恐れがあるため急ブレーキを回避した」等の理由をリアルタイム表示し、現場の不安を解消する
橋梁やトンネルの点検ドローンにおいて、複雑な構造物との距離を正確に保ちながら、最適な飛行ルートを高速に生成し、衝突事故を防止する
建設重機の自動操縦システムにて、周囲の作業員や障害物を避ける際、物理的な限界を考慮した滑らかな動きを生成し、熟練オペレーターに近い操作を実現する

papers.title: Diagnosing Causal Reasoning in Vision-Language Models via Structured Relevance Graphs
papers.abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) achieve strong performance on visual question answering benchmarks, yet often rely on spurious correlations rather than genuine causal reasoning. Existing evaluations primarily assess the correctness of the answers, making it unclear whether failures arise from limited reasoning capability or from misidentifying causally relevant information. We introduce Vision-Language Causal Graphs (VLCGs), a structured, query-conditioned representation that explicitly encodes causally relevant objects, attributes, relations, and scene-grounded assumptions. Building on this representation, we present ViLCaR, a diagnostic benchmark comprising tasks for Causal Attribution, Causal Inference, and Question Answering, along with graph-aligned evaluation metrics that assess relevance identification beyond final answer accuracy. Experiments in state-of-the-art LVLMs show that injecting structured relevance information significantly improves attribution and inference consistency compared to zero-shot and standard in-context learning. These findings suggest that current limitations in LVLM causal reasoning stem primarily from insufficient structural guidance rather than a lack of reasoning capacity.
papers.headline: AIが画像から「なぜそうなるか」の因果関係を正しく推論できる
papers.one_liner: 画像内の物体や属性、それらの関係性をネットワーク図（因果グラフ）として整理してAIに与えることで、AI特有の「あてずっぽうな回答」を減らし、根拠に基づいた論理的な判断（因果推論）を可能にする技術です。
key_points: AIが単なる「画像の特徴のパターン」ではなく、物事の因果関係を理解して回答できるようになる
なぜその結論に至ったのかという「判断の根拠」を構造的に示せるため、AIの誤判断を修正しやすくなる
「Aという状態だからBというリスクがある」といった、現場の熟練者が持つ暗黙知をグラフ形式でAIに注入できる
画像認識の結果に論理的な制約を加えることで、複雑なシーンでも見落としや「AIの思い込み」によるミスを劇的に減らせる
AIに推論の道筋をガイドすることで、少ない学習データでも高度な状況判断を実現できる
who_should_read: PM/プロダクトマネージャー
application_ideas: 工場の労働災害分析において、事故写真から「床の濡れ」→「滑りやすさ」→「転倒」という因果関係を特定し、より本質的な安全対策を自動提案する。
インフラ点検において、橋梁のひび割れ画像に対し「ひびの形状」→「内部鉄筋の腐食」→「構造的危険」という因果パスを提示させ、修理の優先順位を論理的に説明する。
製品検査において、不良箇所の画像から「部品の摩耗」→「摩擦熱の発生」→「変色」という因果関係を特定し、単なる欠陥検知を超えた原因究明に活用する。

papers.title: IG-RFT: An Interaction-Guided RL Framework for VLA Models in Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated significant potential for generalist robotic policies; however, they struggle to generalize to long-horizon complex tasks in novel real-world domains due to distribution shifts and the scarcity of high-quality demonstrations. Although reinforcement learning (RL) offers a promising avenue for policy improvement, applying it to real-world VLA fine-tuning faces challenges regarding exploration efficiency, training stability, and sample cost. To address these issues, we propose IG-RFT, a novel Interaction-Guided Reinforced Fine-Tuning system designed for flow-based VLA models. Firstly, to facilitate effective policy optimization, we introduce Interaction-Guided Advantage Weighted Regression (IG-AWR), an RL algorithm that dynamically modulates exploration intensity based on the robot's interaction status. Furthermore, to address the limitations of sparse or task-specific rewards, we design a novel hybrid dense reward function that integrates the trajectory-level reward and the subtask-level reward. Finally, we construct a three-stage RL system comprising SFT, Offline RL, and Human-in-the-Loop RL for fine-tuning VLA models. Extensive real-world experiments on four challenging long-horizon tasks demonstrate that IG-RFT achieves an average success rate of 85.0%, significantly outperforming SFT (18.8%) and standard Offline RL baselines (40.0%). Ablation studies confirm the critical contributions of IG-AWR and hybrid reward shaping. In summary, our work establishes and validates a novel reinforced fine-tuning system for VLA models in real-world robotic manipulation.
papers.headline: 複雑なロボット操作を成功率85%で完遂させる新AI学習法
papers.one_liner: 見たものと言葉と動きを統合して理解するAI（VLAモデル）が、AI自らの試行錯誤と人間のサポートを組み合わせることで、手順の多い複雑な作業を未知の環境でも確実に実行できるようになります。
key_points: 手順が多い複雑な作業でも、AIが途中で迷わず最後までやり遂げられるようになります。
現場のデータが少なくても、AIが自ら効率的に学習（強化学習）して短期間で適応します。
人間が少し手助けするだけでAIが飛躍的に賢くなる仕組みにより、ゼロから教え込む膨大な手間が省けます。
AIが「今は新しい動きを試すべきか、慎重に動くべきか」を状況に応じて判断し、安全かつ確実に動作します。
作業を細かなステップに分けて評価するため、AIが学習の達成感（報酬）を得やすくなり、習得スピードが向上します。
tags: 熟練技能のデジタル化
who_should_read: PM/プロダクトマネージャー
application_ideas: 工場の多品種少量生産ラインにおいて、手順の異なる複雑な部品組み立てをロボットに素早く学習させ、段取り替えの時間を短縮する。
建設現場の不整地や障害物がある環境で、資材の運搬や配置を現場の状況に合わせて自律的に判断して行うロボットの制御に応用する。
橋梁やダムの点検において、複雑な構造を回避しながらドローンが自律的に最適な撮影ポイントへ移動し、精密な計測を行う際の操縦支援として活用する。

papers.title: GATES: Self-Distillation under Privileged Context with Consensus Gating
papers.abstract: We study self-distillation in settings where supervision is unreliable: there are no ground truth labels, verifiable rewards, or external graders to evaluate answers. We focus on document-grounded question answering with asymmetric context, where a single model serves as both tutor (with access to a relevant source document during training) and student (answering from the question alone at test time). Rather than assuming tutor correctness, we derive supervision online from tutor consensus by sampling multiple document-grounded reasoning traces and using agreement to gate learning. Conditioned on this reliability signal, we distill knowledge through full tutor reasoning trajectories (not just final answers), providing a dense and stable learning signal. Empirically, this consensus-gated trajectory distillation substantially improves transfer to the document-free student. Held-out in-domain accuracy under asymmetric evaluation improves from 46.0\% to 62.0\%, and average (maj@8) accuracy on public document-free math benchmarks improves from 20.2\% to 35.4\%.
papers.headline: 正解がない環境でも、AIが自学自習で賢くなる
papers.one_liner: 正解データ（教師ラベル）がなくても、AIが資料を読み込んだ「先生役」と資料なしで解く「生徒役」を一人二役でこなし、複数の「考え方のプロセス」が一致した時だけ学習することで、知識を効率的に継承する技術です。
key_points: 人間が正解（ラベル）を用意しなくても、AIだけで学習を回せる
資料を見ながら解いた「考え方の道筋」を丸ごと学ぶため、単なる暗記ではなく応用が効く
複数の回答案が一致した時（コンセンサス）だけ学習に使うため、AIの「思い込み」を学習するリスクを減らせる
推論の精度が大幅に向上し、数学などの難問でも正答率が15%以上アップした実績がある
学習時にだけ膨大なマニュアルや図面を参照させ、本番（推論時）は身軽に動くAIを作れる
who_should_read: PM/プロダクトマネージャー
application_ideas: 【図面チェック】膨大な施工基準書を参照できる「先生AI」が、基準書を読み込まなくても図面を見ただけで違和感を察知する「現場用軽量AI」にチェックの勘所を教え込む。
【インフラ点検】過去の膨大な点検記録や図面を読み込んだ「ベテランAI」の思考プロセスを、現場のカメラ映像だけで異常を判定する「新人AI」に移植し、オフライン環境での判断精度を高める。
【工場検査】不具合事例集を学習した「先生AI」が、検査画像だけを見る「生徒AI」に対し、どこが不具合の根拠になるかの「推論の道筋」を教えることで、見落としを減らす。

papers.title: LogicGraph : Benchmarking Multi-Path Logical Reasoning via Neuro-Symbolic Generation and Verification
papers.abstract: Evaluations of large language models (LLMs) primarily emphasize convergent logical reasoning, where success is defined by producing a single correct proof. However, many real-world reasoning problems admit multiple valid derivations, requiring models to explore diverse logical paths rather than committing to one route. To address this limitation, we introduce LogicGraph, the first benchmark aimed to systematically evaluate multi-path logical reasoning, constructed via a neuro-symbolic framework that leverages backward logic generation and semantic instantiation. This pipeline yields solver-verified reasoning problems formalized by high-depth multi-path reasoning and inherent logical distractions, where each instance is associated with an exhaustive set of minimal proofs. We further propose a reference-free evaluation framework to rigorously assess model performance in both convergent and divergent regimes. Experiments on state-of-the-art language models reveal a common limitation: models tend to commit early to a single route and fail to explore alternatives, and the coverage gap grows substantially with reasoning depth. LogicGraph exposes this divergence gap and provides actionable insights to motivate future improvements. Our code and data will be released at https://github.com/kkkkarry/LogicGraph.
papers.headline: AIが「別の解決策」を網羅的に提案できるようになる
papers.one_liner: AIが1つの正解だけでなく、複数の正しい解決手順（マルチパス推論）を導き出せるかを厳密にテストする手法です。AIが特定の解法に固執する「思い込み」を可視化し、より柔軟な思考を可能にします。
key_points: 「Aも正解だがBという道もある」といった、現実社会に近い多角的な判断力をAIが持っているか測定できる
AIが最初の思い込みで突っ走り、他の可能性を無視してしまう弱点（早期コミットメント）を浮き彫りにできる
逆算ロジックを用いて、人間でも解くのが難しい「論理の罠」を含むテスト用問題を自動生成できる
複数の正解ルートを全て導き出す必要がある、高度なシミュレーション業務への適性を客観的に評価できる
AIの出した答えだけでなく「推論のプロセス」が正しいかを機械的に検証できるため、信頼性の評価が容易になる
who_should_read: PM/プロダクトマネージャー
application_ideas: 工場の設備故障時に、考えられる複数の原因と復旧手順をAIが網羅的に提示し、ベテランの見落としや新人の判断ミスを防ぐ診断ツール。
図面チェックの工程で、設計ミスに対して「コスト優先」「工期優先」「安全性優先」など、論理的に妥当な複数の修正案をAIに提示させる機能。
インフラ点検の計画策定で、予算や車両通行規制の条件を変えた複数の点検ルートパターンをAIが自動生成し、最適な意思決定をサポートする。

papers.title: MUSE: Harnessing Precise and Diverse Semantics for Few-Shot Whole Slide Image Classification
papers.abstract: In computational pathology, few-shot whole slide image classification is primarily driven by the extreme scarcity of expert-labeled slides. Recent vision-language methods incorporate textual semantics generated by large language models, but treat these descriptions as static class-level priors that are shared across all samples and lack sample-wise refinement. This limits both the diversity and precision of visual-semantic alignment, hindering generalization under limited supervision. To overcome this, we propose the stochastic MUlti-view Semantic Enhancement (MUSE), a framework that first refines semantic precision via sample-wise adaptation and then enhances semantic richness through retrieval-augmented multi-view generation. Specifically, MUSE introduces Sample-wise Fine-grained Semantic Enhancement (SFSE), which yields a fine-grained semantic prior for each sample through MoE-based adaptive visual-semantic interaction. Guided by this prior, Stochastic Multi-view Model Optimization (SMMO) constructs an LLM-generated knowledge base of diverse pathological descriptions per class, then retrieves and stochastically integrates multiple matched textual views during training. These dynamically selected texts serve as enriched semantic supervisions to stochastically optimize the vision-language model, promoting robustness and mitigating overfitting. Experiments on three benchmark WSI datasets show that MUSE consistently outperforms existing vision-language baselines in few-shot settings, demonstrating that effective few-shot pathology learning requires not only richer semantic sources but also their active and sample-aware semantic optimization. Our code is available at: https://github.com/JiahaoXu-god/CVPR2026_MUSE.
papers.headline: 少ない画像でも専門知識を活かしてAIが正確に自動診断
papers.one_liner: 専門医によるラベル付けデータが極端に少ない分野でも、大規模言語モデルが持つ膨大な専門知識を画像一枚ごとの特徴に合わせて柔軟に組み合わせることで、高精度な画像分類（病理診断）を実現する技術です。
key_points: 熟練者による膨大なラベル付け作業（アノテーション）の負担を大幅に軽減できる
画像ごとにAIが「どこに注目すべきか」を微調整するため、診断の根拠が明確になる
辞書的な一律の説明ではなく、多様な表現で学習するため未知のパターンに強くなる
専門知識（LLM内の知見）を画像解析に自動で取り込み、AIの「思い込み」を防げる
データが少ないときに起きがちな「特定のデータだけに偏った学習（過学習）」を抑制できる
who_should_read: PM/プロダクトマネージャー
application_ideas: インフラ点検の場面で、過去に数例しかない特殊な腐食やひび割れを、点検マニュアルの知識をAIに読み込ませて高精度に検知する
工場の外観検査において、新製品のわずかな不良品サンプルと仕様書のテキスト情報を組み合わせて、即座に検査ラインを稼働させる
図面チェックの場面で、記号の形状だけでなく「なぜその配置が必要か」という設計基準の知識をLLM経由で参照させ、判断ミスを減らす

papers.title: WeirNet: A Large-Scale 3D CFD Benchmark for Geometric Surrogate Modeling of Piano Key Weirs
papers.abstract: Reliable prediction of hydraulic performance is challenging for Piano Key Weir (PKW) design because discharge capacity depends on three-dimensional geometry and operating conditions. Surrogate models can accelerate hydraulic-structure design, but progress is limited by scarce large, well-documented datasets that jointly capture geometric variation, operating conditions, and functional performance. This study presents WeirNet, a large 3D CFD benchmark dataset for geometric surrogate modeling of PKWs. WeirNet contains 3,794 parametric, feasibility-constrained rectangular and trapezoidal PKW geometries, each scheduled at 19 discharge conditions using a consistent free-surface OpenFOAM workflow, resulting in 71,387 completed simulations that form the benchmark and with complete discharge coefficient labels. The dataset is released as multiple modalities compact parametric descriptors, watertight surface meshes and high-resolution point clouds together with standardized tasks and in-distribution and out-of-distribution splits. Representative surrogate families are benchmarked for discharge coefficient prediction. Tree-based regressors on parametric descriptors achieve the best overall accuracy, while point- and mesh-based models remain competitive and offer parameterization-agnostic inference. All surrogates evaluate in milliseconds per sample, providing orders-of-magnitude speedups over CFD runtimes. Out-of-distribution results identify geometry shift as the dominant failure mode compared to unseen discharge values, and data-efficiency experiments show diminishing returns beyond roughly 60% of the training data. By publicly releasing the dataset together with simulation setups and evaluation pipelines, WeirNet establishes a reproducible framework for data-driven hydraulic modeling and enables faster exploration of PKW designs during the early stages of hydraulic planning.
papers.headline: ダムの放流設備設計をAIが数ミリ秒でシミュレーション可能にする
papers.one_liner: 複雑な形状のダム放流設備（ピアノキー堰）の性能を、膨大な計算が必要な物理演算（CFD）の代わりにAIが3D形状から即座に予測する技術（代理モデル）を提案しています。
key_points: 数日かかる専門的な水理計算を、AIが数ミリ秒という一瞬の速さで完了できる
7万件以上のシミュレーション結果に基づき、未知の形状でもAIが高い精度で性能を言い当てる
3Dモデル（点群やメッシュ）をそのまま扱えるため、設計用CADソフトとの連携がスムーズになる
初期設計の段階で、数百通りの形状案をリアルタイムで比較検討し、最適な形を見つけ出せる
AI学習用の膨大なデータセットが公開されたことで、土木インフラ専用AIの開発が加速する
who_should_read: PM/プロダクトマネージャー
application_ideas: 橋梁やトンネルの構造設計において、BIM上で形状を微調整しながら、その場で強度や耐久性の変化をリアルタイムで可視化するツール
河川の護岸ブロック配置を検討する際、増水時の水の流れをAIが即座にシミュレーションし、最適な配置を自動提案するシステム
工場の複雑な配管設計で、圧力損失や流体効率が最適になる形状をAIが3D点群データから瞬時に判別し、設計の手戻りを防ぐ

papers.title: CAMEL: Confidence-Gated Reflection for Reward Modeling
papers.abstract: Reward models play a fundamental role in aligning large language models with human preferences. Existing methods predominantly follow two paradigms: scalar discriminative preference models, which are efficient but lack interpretability, and generative judging models, which offer richer reasoning at the cost of higher computational overhead. We observe that the log-probability margin between verdict tokens strongly correlates with prediction correctness, providing a reliable proxy for instance difficulty without additional inference cost. Building on this insight, we propose CAMEL, a confidence-gated reflection framework that performs a lightweight single-token preference decision first and selectively invokes reflection only for low-confidence instances. To induce effective self-correction, we train the model via reinforcement learning with counterfactual prefix augmentation, which exposes the model to diverse initial verdicts and encourages genuine revision. Empirically, CAMEL achieves state-of-the-art performance on three widely used reward-model benchmarks with 82.9% average accuracy, surpassing the best prior model by 3.2% and outperforming 70B-parameter models using only 14B parameters, while establishing a strictly better accuracy-efficiency Pareto frontier.
papers.headline: 「迷った時だけAIが考え直す」仕組みで判断精度を劇的に向上
papers.one_liner: AIが自分の回答の自信度を瞬時に測定し、確信が持てない場合のみ「熟考（リフレクション）」を行うことで、低コストながら超大型モデルを上回る正確な判断（報酬モデル）を実現します。
key_points: AI自身が「自分の判断が怪しい」と気づくため、見落としやAIの思い込み（ハルシネーション）を効果的に防げる
全てのケースを深掘りするのではなく、必要な時だけ熟考するため、処理速度と精度のバランスが非常に良い
140億パラメータの中型AIで、その5倍のサイズ（700億）の巨大AIを超える正解率を達成した
あえて「逆の結論」を想定して訓練されており、一度決めたことに固執せず柔軟に間違いを修正できる
判断の根拠を説明させるプロセスを自動制御できるため、人間がチェックすべき重要な箇所が明確になる
who_should_read: PM/プロダクトマネージャー
application_ideas: インフラ点検：ひび割れ判定において、明らかな異常・正常は即座に判別し、判断が難しいグレーゾーンの画像のみAIに「なぜそう判断したか」を再考・説明させることで、点検員の確認工数を削減する。
図面チェック：数万箇所の整合性確認を高速で行いつつ、複雑な法令や基準が絡む箇所だけ「セルフチェックモード」を起動させ、見落としが許されない重要箇所の検知精度を極限まで高める。
工場検査：製造ラインの異物検査で、通常は高速判定を行い、判別しにくい影やノイズが含まれる場合のみ詳細解析ロジックを走らせることで、ライン速度を落とさずに誤検知を最小化する。

papers.title: AnimeAgent: Is the Multi-Agent via Image-to-Video models a Good Disney Storytelling Artist?
papers.abstract: Custom Storyboard Generation (CSG) aims to produce high-quality, multi-character consistent storytelling. Current approaches based on static diffusion models, whether used in a one-shot manner or within multi-agent frameworks, face three key limitations: (1) Static models lack dynamic expressiveness and often resort to "copy-paste" pattern. (2) One-shot inference cannot iteratively correct missing attributes or poor prompt adherence. (3) Multi-agents rely on non-robust evaluators, ill-suited for assessing stylized, non-realistic animation. To address these, we propose AnimeAgent, the first Image-to-Video (I2V)-based multi-agent framework for CSG. Inspired by Disney's "Combination of Straight Ahead and Pose to Pose" workflow, AnimeAgent leverages I2V's implicit motion prior to enhance consistency and expressiveness, while a mixed subjective-objective reviewer enables reliable iterative refinement. We also collect a human-annotated CSG benchmark with ground-truth. Experiments show AnimeAgent achieves SOTA performance in consistency, prompt fidelity, and stylization.
papers.headline: キャラの見た目を維持したままアニメ制作をAIが自動完結する
papers.one_liner: 物語の台本から、登場人物の見た目を固定したまま生き生きとしたアニメーション（絵コンテ）を生成する技術です。「画像から動画を作るAI（I2V）」と「AI同士が評価・修正し合う仕組み（マルチエージェント）」を組み合わせ、ディズニー映画のような一貫性を実現します。
key_points: 場面が変わってもキャラクターが別人にならない「見た目の一貫性」を高い精度で維持できる
静止画の切り貼り感がない、キャラクターの動きや表情に躍動感があるアニメを自動生成できる
AI同士が「指示通りか」「絵が崩れていないか」を相互チェックし、納得いくまで自動で描き直す
プロの制作現場（ディズニーの手法）を再現した手順で、人間が自然と感じるストーリー構成を作る
実写だけでなくアニメ特有の表現を正しく評価できる指標により、品質のバラつきを抑えられる
who_should_read: PM/プロダクトマネージャー
application_ideas: 工場作業の安全マニュアルにおいて、特定のキャラクターが正しい手順で動く教育用アニメを、テキストの指示だけで大量に作成する。
BIM/CIMの3Dモデル空間で、点検員が複雑な経路を移動し点検を行うシミュレーション動画を生成し、現場の危険予知トレーニングに活用する。
インフラの劣化予測データをもとに、時間の経過とともにひび割れがどう広がるかをアニメ化し、修繕計画の必要性を非専門家に直感的に伝える。

papers.title: RobustVisRAG: Causality-Aware Vision-Based Retrieval-Augmented Generation under Visual Degradations
papers.abstract: Vision-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation (VisRAG) leverages vision-language models (VLMs) to jointly retrieve relevant visual documents and generate grounded answers based on multimodal evidence. However, existing VisRAG models degrade in performance when visual inputs suffer from distortions such as blur, noise, low light, or shadow, where semantic and degradation factors become entangled within pretrained visual encoders, leading to errors in both retrieval and generation stages. To address this limitation, we introduce RobustVisRAG, a causality-guided dual-path framework that improves VisRAG robustness while preserving efficiency and zero-shot generalization. RobustVisRAG uses a non-causal path to capture degradation signals through unidirectional attention and a causal path to learn purified semantics guided by these signals. Together with the proposed Non-Causal Distortion Modeling and Causal Semantic Alignment objectives, the framework enforces a clear separation between semantics and degradations, enabling stable retrieval and generation under challenging visual conditions. To evaluate robustness under realistic conditions, we introduce the Distortion-VisRAG dataset, a large-scale benchmark containing both synthetic and real-world degraded documents across seven domains, with 12 synthetic and 5 real distortion types that comprehensively reflect practical visual degradations. Experimental results show that RobustVisRAG improves retrieval, generation, and end-to-end performance by 7.35%, 6.35%, and 12.40%, respectively, on real-world degradations, while maintaining comparable accuracy on clean inputs.
papers.headline: ぼやけた写真や暗い図面からでもAIが正確に情報を読み取れる
papers.one_liner: 画像と文字を同時に扱うAI（VisRAG）において、ノイズや暗所などの「画質の悪さ」の影響をAI自らが切り離して処理することで、不鮮明な資料からでも必要な情報を探し出し、正確に回答できるようになります。
key_points: 現場で撮影したピンぼけや影がある写真でも、AIが内容を誤解する「思い込み」を大幅に減らせる
劣悪な環境で撮られた点検資料や古い図面から、必要なデータだけを的確に見つけ出せる
画質が悪い画像による検索・回答エラーが、実地テストで12%以上改善し安定性が向上する
高品質な画像に対しては精度を落とすことなく、条件が悪い画像に対してのみ特効薬として機能する
撮り直しが困難な現場の証拠写真や、スキャン状態の悪い文書のデータ化が劇的にスムーズになる
who_should_read: 図面認識・照査AIエンジニア
PM/プロダクトマネージャー
application_ideas: トンネルや橋梁の暗い場所で撮影した点検写真の解析において、照度不足によるノイズをAIが無視し、ひび割れの状況や過去の記録を正確に照合・整理する業務に活用できる
汚れや折り目、日焼けがある古い紙図面のスキャンデータから、AIがノイズと必要な線を分離して読み取ることで、BIMモデル化に必要な寸法情報の抽出精度を向上させる

papers.title: DySCO: Dynamic Attention-Scaling Decoding for Long-Context LMs
papers.abstract: Understanding and reasoning over long contexts is a crucial capability for language models (LMs). Although recent models support increasingly long context windows, their accuracy often deteriorates as input length grows. In practice, models often struggle to keep attention aligned with the most relevant context throughout decoding. In this work, we propose DySCO, a novel decoding algorithm for improving long-context reasoning. DySCO leverages retrieval heads--a subset of attention heads specialized for long-context retrieval--to identify task-relevant tokens at each decoding step and explicitly up-weight them. By doing so, DySCO dynamically adjusts attention during generation to better utilize relevant context. The method is training-free and can be applied directly to any off-the-shelf LMs. Across multiple instruction-tuned and reasoning models, DySCO consistently improves performance on challenging long-context reasoning benchmarks, yielding relative gains of up to 25% on MRCR and LongBenchV2 at 128K context length with modest additional compute. Further analysis highlights the importance of both dynamic attention rescaling and retrieval-head-guided selection for the effectiveness of the method, while providing interpretability insights into decoding-time attention behavior. Our code is available at https://github.com/princeton-pli/DySCO.
papers.headline: 膨大な資料から「必要な情報」をAIが迷わず見つけ出す
papers.one_liner: 大量の文書を読み込ませた際にAIが重要な情報を見失う問題を、情報検索が得意な特定の回路（レトリバーヘッド）の注目度を動的に高めることで解決します。追加学習（ファインチューニング）なしで、既存のAIにそのまま導入して「情報の見落とし」を減らせる技術です。
key_points: 10万文字を超えるような超長文の資料でも、AIが文脈の核心を外さずに理解できるようになる
追加の学習やデータの準備が一切不要で、今あるAIモデルの「回答の出し方」を変えるだけで精度が上がる
質問に関連する箇所をAIが自ら特定して強調するため、もっともらしい嘘をつく「AIの思い込み（ハルシネーション）」が大幅に減る
特定の情報を探し出す能力が最大25%向上し、複雑な推論が必要なタスクでも安定したパフォーマンスを発揮する
AIが文書のどこを重視して回答したのかが可視化されるため、業務で利用する際の納得感や信頼性が高まる
who_should_read: PM/プロダクトマネージャー
application_ideas: 数千ページに及ぶ大型プラントの保守点検マニュアルから、特定の型番の部品交換手順と注意点を一瞬で、かつ正確に抽出する
過去数十年にわたるインフラ点検報告書の膨大なテキスト群から、現在の異常箇所と類似した過去の劣化事例や補修履歴を漏らさずリストアップする
複雑な建設関連法規や自治体独自の条例集をすべて読み込ませ、設計図面の仕様がどの条項に抵触する可能性があるかを、根拠条文を明示しながらチェックする

papers.title: Hierarchical LLM-Based Multi-Agent Framework with Prompt Optimization for Multi-Robot Task Planning
papers.abstract: Multi-robot task planning requires decomposing natural-language instructions into executable actions for heterogeneous robot teams. Conventional Planning Domain Definition Language (PDDL) planners provide rigorous guarantees but struggle to handle ambiguous or long-horizon missions, while large language models (LLMs) can interpret instructions and propose plans but may hallucinate or produce infeasible actions. We present a hierarchical multi-agent LLM-based planner with prompt optimization: an upper layer decomposes tasks and assigns them to lower-layer agents, which generate PDDL problems solved by a classical planner. When plans fail, the system applies TextGrad-inspired textual-gradient updates to optimize each agent's prompt and thereby improve planning accuracy. In addition, meta-prompts are learned and shared across agents within the same layer, enabling efficient prompt optimization in multi-agent settings. On the MAT-THOR benchmark, our planner achieves success rates of 0.95 on compound tasks, 0.84 on complex tasks, and 0.60 on vague tasks, improving over the previous state-of-the-art LaMMA-P by 2, 7, and 15 percentage points respectively. An ablation study shows that the hierarchical structure, prompt optimization, and meta-prompt sharing contribute roughly +59, +37, and +4 percentage points to the overall success rate.
papers.headline: 曖昧な指示でも複数ロボットが協力し、任務を自動完遂できる
papers.one_liner: 「現場を片付けて」のような大まかな言葉（自然言語指示）をAIが具体的な手順に分解し、失敗しても自ら指示内容（プロンプト）を修正してやり直すことで、複数ロボットへの正確な役割分担を可能にします。
key_points: 曖昧で抽象的な命令から、ロボットが実行できるレベルの具体的な作業手順を自動で作成できる
複数のロボットに対し、それぞれの特性に合わせた最適な役割分担をAIが自動で行う
計画通りにいかない場合、AIが「なぜ失敗したか」を分析して指示文を自ら書き換え、成功率を高める
従来のAIが苦手としていた「複雑で長期的な作業」でも、9割以上の高い成功率を実現している
ロボット間での「作業のコツ（メタプロンプト）」の共有により、チーム全体の動きが効率化される
who_should_read: PM/プロダクトマネージャー
application_ideas: 物流倉庫のピッキング：複数台のロボットに「棚卸し」を指示するだけで、AIが棚の確認と移動を分担し、進路が塞がるなどのトラブルも自律的に解決する。
インフラの複合点検：ドローンと走行ロボットのチームに「橋梁点検」を指示。ドローンが上部、ロボットが下部といった役割をAIが自動生成し、撮影漏れがあれば指示を自己修正して完遂する。
建設現場の資材運搬：複数の搬送ロボットに「資材をA地点へ」と指示。AIが障害物や各機体の充電残量を考慮して最適な配送ルートと分担を決め、現場の状況変化に即座に対応する。

papers.title: FewMMBench: A Benchmark for Multimodal Few-Shot Learning
papers.abstract: As multimodal large language models (MLLMs) advance in handling interleaved image-text data, assessing their few-shot learning capabilities remains an open challenge. In this paper, we introduce FewMMBench, a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate MLLMs under few-shot conditions, with a focus on In-Context Learning (ICL) and Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting. Covering a diverse suite of multimodal understanding tasks, from attribute recognition to temporal reasoning, FewMMBench enables systematic analysis across task types, model families, and prompting strategies. We evaluate 26 open-weight MLLMs from six model families across zero-shot, few-shot, and CoT-augmented few-shot settings. Our findings reveal that instruction-tuned models exhibit strong zero-shot performance but benefit minimally, or even regress, with additional demonstrations or CoT reasoning. Retrieval-based demonstrations and increased context size also yield limited gains. These results highlight FewMMBench as a rigorous testbed for diagnosing and advancing few-shot capabilities in multimodal LLMs. The data is available at: https://huggingface.co/datasets/mustafaa/FewMMBench
papers.headline: 手本を数件見せるだけでAIの画像解析力を正確に判定できる
papers.one_liner: 画像とテキストが混ざったデータに対し、わずかな手本（少読学習／Few-shot）を与えるだけでAIがどこまで賢くなるかを厳密に測定するテスト手法を開発しました。これにより、現場で「AIにどう指示を出せば賢くなるか」の限界を明らかにできます。
key_points: わずか数件の画像付きの例を見せるだけで、AIが未知の作業に対応できるか判定できる
手本を増やすことが必ずしも精度向上に繋がらず、逆効果になるAIの弱点が特定できる
「考え方の手順（思考の連鎖／CoT）」を教えても画像認識では効果が薄い場合があると判明
現場ごとに異なる特殊なデータに対し、AIがどれだけ柔軟に適応できるか数値化できる
最新の26種類のAIモデルを比較し、自社の用途に最適なAIモデルの選定基準が作れる
who_should_read: PM/プロダクトマネージャー
application_ideas: 工場の不具合検品において、数枚の不良品写真を見せるだけでAIが即座に検知できるか、導入前にこの指標を使って性能の限界を予測する。
橋梁やトンネルの点検で、現場特有の損傷パターンを数例学習させた際に、AIが混乱せずに正しく判定できるかを検証するテスト工程として活用する。
