Unlike traditional database plan caching (which optimizes for frequency), CacheRAG introduces three novel design principles tailored for LLM contexts: (1) Schema-agnostic user interface: A two-stage semantic parsing framework via Intermediate Semantic Representation (ISR) enables non-expert users to interact purely in natural language, while a Backend Adapter grounds the LLM with local schema context to compile executable physical queries safely. (2) Diversity-optimized cache retrieval: A two-layer hierarchical index (Domain $\rightarrow$ Aspect) coupled with Maximal Marginal Relevance (MMR) maximizes structural variety in cached examples, effectively mitigating reasoning homogeneity. (3) Bounded heuristic expansion: Deterministic depth and breadth subgraph operators with strict complexity guarantees significantly enhance retrieval recall without risking unbounded API execution. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that CacheRAG significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines (e.g., +13.2% accuracy and +17.5% truthfulness on the CRAG dataset).
papers.headline: 複雑な社内情報のAI検索が正確になり、知ったかぶりも防ぐ
papers.one_liner: 膨大な知識データから情報を探す際、過去の成功パターンを「お手本」として再利用する仕組みです。専門的なデータ構造を知らなくても日常の言葉で質問でき、AIが勝手な嘘をでっち上げる（ハルシネーション）のを防ぎながら正確な回答を導き出します。
key_points: 専門知識がなくても、現場で使う普通の言葉でデータベースに複雑な質問ができるようになります。
過去の「良い検索の仕道筋」をAIが学習して蓄積するため、使えば使うほど回答の精度が上がります。
AIが勝手なデータ構造を想像して回答する「知ったかぶり」を抑え、信頼性の高い情報提供が可能です。
似たような過去事例ばかりでなく、多様な視点から情報を検索して回答の質を高める工夫がされています。
検索にかかる時間や負荷をAIが自動でコントロールするため、システムのパンクや高額な利用料を抑えられます。
who_should_read: PM/プロダクトマネージャー
application_ideas: 「工場の設備保守」の場面で、過去数十年分の故障履歴と対応マニュアルをAIに学習させれば、現場作業員が「異音がした時の過去の類似対応」を自然な会話で即座に引き出せ、修理ミスを減らせます。
「BIM/CIMの部材検索」の場面で、膨大な3Dモデル内の属性情報に対し、「特定の工区で使われている、耐用年数が近い部材をリストアップして」といった複雑な抽出を、専門ソフトの操作なしで正確に行えるようになります。
「橋梁やトンネルの点検業務」の場面で、過去の点検写真と所見データをAIが横断的に検索し、「今回のひび割れと酷似した過去の進行事例」を提示することで、熟練者でなくても適切な判定を下せるよう支援できます。

papers.title: MedSynapse-V: Bridging Visual Perception and Clinical Intuition via Latent Memory Evolution
papers.abstract: High-precision medical diagnosis relies not only on static imaging features but also on the implicit diagnostic memory experts instantly invoke during image interpretation. We pinpoint a fundamental cognitive misalignment in medical VLMs caused by discrete tokenization, leading to quantization loss, long-range information dissipation, and missing case-adaptive expertise. To bridge this gap, we propose ours, a framework for latent diagnostic memory evolution that simulates the experiential invocation of clinicians by dynamically synthesizing implicit diagnostic memories within the model's hidden stream. Specifically, it begins with a Meta Query for Prior Memorization mechanism, where learnable probes retrieve structured priors from an anatomical prior encoder to generate condensed implicit memories. To ensure clinical fidelity, we introduce Causal Counterfactual Refinement (CCR), which leverages reinforcement learning and counterfactual rewards derived from region-level feature masking to quantify the causal contribution of each memory, thereby pruning redundancies and aligning latent representations with diagnostic logic. This evolutionary process culminates in Intrinsic Memory Transition (IMT), a privileged-autonomous dual-branch paradigm that internalizes teacher-branch diagnostic patterns into the student-branch via full-vocabulary divergence alignment. Comprehensive empirical evaluations across multiple datasets demonstrate that ours, by transferring external expertise into endogenous parameters, significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods, particularly chain-of-thought paradigms, in diagnostic accuracy.
papers.headline: 医師の「経験則」をAIが習得し、画像診断の精度が飛躍的に向上
papers.one_liner: 医師が画像を見た瞬間に働かせる「直感的な診断メモリ」をAIの内部データ（潜在的な記憶）として再現し、より正確な判断を可能にします。画像を部分的に隠して「もしここが正常なら？」と検証する仕組み（因果関係の学習）により、AIの思い込みを防ぎ、診断の根拠を強固にしています。
key_points: ベテラン医師が持つ「言葉にできない診断のコツ」をAIの内部知識として組み込める
「もしこの異常がなかったら」という仮説検証をAIが自ら行い、判断ミスを大幅に減らせる
解剖学的な重要ポイントをAIが自動的に絞り込むため、診断の根拠が明確になる
外部の専門知識をAI自身の能力として完全に吸収（内面化）させ、高速かつ高精度な回答が可能
従来の「順を追って考える（思考の連鎖）」方式よりも、直感的かつ正確に病変を見抜けるようになる
who_should_read: PM/プロダクトマネージャー
application_ideas: 橋梁やトンネルのインフラ点検において、ベテラン点検員の「このヒビの入り方は内部が危ない」という長年の勘をAIに学習させ、重大な損傷の見落としを防止する。
工場の製品外観検査で、傷の一部を隠して「もしここがなければ良品か？」をAIに自問自答させることで、汚れと本当の欠陥を正確に見分ける品質検査AIを実現する。
BIMや設計図面のチェックにおいて、単なる寸法のミスだけでなく「この構造ならここが弱点になるはず」という設計士の論理的な直感をAIに反映させ、構造上の不備を自動で指摘する。

papers.title: ClassEval-Pro: A Cross-Domain Benchmark for Class-Level Code Generation
papers.abstract: LLMs have achieved strong results on both function-level code synthesis and repository-level code modification, yet a capability that falls between these two extremes -- compositional code creation, i.e., building a complete, internally structured class from a specification -- remains underserved. Current evaluations are either confined to isolated functions or rely on manually curated class-level tasks that are expensive to scale and increasingly susceptible to data contamination. We introduce ClassEval-Pro, a benchmark of 300 class-level tasks spanning 11 domains, constructed through an automated three-stage pipeline that combines complexity enhancement, cross-domain class composition, and integration of real-world GitHub code contributed after January 2025. Every task is validated by an LLM Judge Ensemble and must pass test suites with over 90% line coverage. We evaluate five frontier LLMs under five generation strategies. The best model achieves only 45.6% class-level Pass@1, with a 17.7-point gap between the strongest and weakest models, confirming the benchmark's discriminative power. Strategy choice strongly interacts with model capability: structured approaches such as bottom-up improve weaker models by up to 9.4 percentage points, while compositional generation collapses to as low as 1.3%. Error analysis over 500 manually annotated failures reveals that logic errors (56.2%) and dependency errors (38.0%) dominate, identifying cross-method coordination as the core bottleneck.
papers.headline: AIによる「複雑なプログラム一式」の作成能力が正確に測れる
papers.one_liner: 断片的なコードではなく、複数の機能が連携する「クラス（プログラムの構造単位）」をAIがどれだけ正確に作れるかを、2025年以降の最新データで厳密に評価（ベンチマーク）できます。
key_points: AIが単なる「命令の穴埋め」ではなく、実用的な「部品の組み合わせ」を作れるか実力がわかる
2025年以降の最新コードを使っているため、AIが学習済みデータから「丸暗記」で回答するのを防げる
11種類の幅広い分野の課題が含まれており、自社の開発領域に近い性能を客観的に比較できる
AIの弱点は「機能間の連携ミス」であることが判明し、開発時のチェックポイントが明確になる
「下から順番に作らせる」などの指示の工夫（プロンプト戦略）で、AIの回答精度が大きく変わることがわかる
tags: ソフトウェア開発効率化
who_should_read: PM/プロダクトマネージャー
application_ideas: BIMソフトのカスタムプラグイン開発において、AIが生成した「複数の機能が連動するコード」が実用に耐えうるか評価する基準として活用し、開発工数を削減する。
工場の外観検査システムで、カメラ制御・画像解析・NG通知といった一連の処理をAIに一括生成させる際、連携ミスによるバグを未然に防ぐためのテスト手法として応用する。
図面チェック自動化ツールの開発で、法規確認や整合性チェックなど、複雑に絡み合う判定ロジックをAIに組ませる際の信頼性測定ツールとして導入する。

papers.title: SecMate: Multi-Agent Adaptive Cybersecurity Troubleshooting with Tri-Context Personalization
papers.abstract: Recent advances in large language models and agentic frameworks have enabled virtual customer assistants (VCAs) for complex support. We present SecMate, a multi-agent VCA for cybersecurity troubleshooting that integrates device, user, and service specificity from conversational and device-level signals. Device specificity is provided by a lightweight local diagnostic utility, while user specificity relies on implicit proficiency inference and profile-aware troubleshooting. Service specificity is achieved through a proactive, context-aware recommender. We evaluate SecMate in a controlled study with 144 participants and 711 conversations. Device-level evidence increased correct resolutions from about 50% to over 90% relative to an LLM-only baseline, while step-by-step guidance improved pleasantness and reduced user burden. The recommender achieved high relevance (MRR@1=0.75), and participants showed strong willingness to substitute human IT support at costs well below human benchmarks. We release the full code base and a richly annotated dataset to support reproducible research on adaptive VCAs.
papers.headline: ITトラブルをAIが状況把握して自力で解決できるようになる
papers.one_liner: PCの状態や使う人の知識レベルを複数のAI（マルチエージェント）が自動で読み取り、専門家のように最適な解決手順を提案する仕組み。従来は約5割だった正解率を9割以上にまで引き上げ、サポートの負担を激減させます。
key_points: PCの内部ログをAIが直接チェックするため、ユーザーが状況を詳しく説明する手間が不要になる
相手が初心者か熟練者かをAIが推測し、その人の知識レベルに合わせた分かりやすい言葉でガイドしてくれる
トラブル解決だけでなく、「次はこの設定をすべき」という先回りした便利な提案ができる
専門のITサポートに頼る場面を大幅に減らせるため、外注費や人件費の大幅なコストカットにつながる
一歩ずつの丁寧なナビゲーションにより、複雑な設定操作でもユーザーが迷わず心理的負担が減る
who_should_read: PM/プロダクトマネージャー
application_ideas: 工場の機械故障時に、装置のエラー信号と作業員の習熟度をAIが即座に分析し、その場で最適な復旧手順をタブレットに表示する「現場向けトラブル解決ガイド」として活用する。
BIM/CIMソフトの複雑な操作で迷った際、プロジェクトの設定状況とユーザーの過去の操作傾向から、次に必要な手順を先回りして教示する「CAD操作パーソナルコーチ」として導入する。
インフラ点検現場で計測機器の接続不良が起きた際、現場の通信環境や機器のログをAIが診断し、技術者が現場で即座に自己解決できる「スマート点検支援ツール」に組み込む。

papers.title: Probabilistic data quality assessment for structural monitoring data via outlier-resistant conditional diffusion model
papers.abstract: Data quality assessment is an essential step that ensures the reliability of the subsequent structural health monitoring (SHM) tasks. This study proposes a prediction deviation-based SHM data quality assessment method using a univariate implicit auto-regressive model, enabling outlier diagnosis and data cleaning. The proposed conditional diffusion model (CDM) augments the standard diffusion model with a conditional embedding module to incorporate temporal context, quartile normalization to mitigate distribution skew, and a Huber loss to enhance robustness against outliers. Within this univariate implicit autoregressive framework, each data point is assigned an outlier probability, quantifying its degree of "outlier-ness", and a global quality evaluation score is computed to characterize the overall dataset quality. Extensive case studies utilizing operational data from real-world structures demonstrate that the proposed framework significantly improves the accuracy of data quality assessment, outperforming other strong baselines representative of clustering, isolation-based, and deep reconstruction methods. The effectiveness and robustness of the proposed framework are further demonstrated by the findings of ablation experiments and hyperparameter analysis.
papers.headline: センサーの異常値をAIが自動判別し、点検精度を向上させる
papers.one_liner: 構造物に設置したセンサーデータの「怪しさ」を確率で判定し、ノイズを除去してデータの信頼性を高める技術です。画像生成AIで使われる拡散モデル（データのパターンを学習する手法）を応用し、前後の流れから不自然な数値を特定します。
key_points: データの「怪しさ」を0〜100%の確率で算出できるため、点検結果の信憑性が客観的に判断できる
データに大きなノイズや偏りがあっても、AIがそれに惑わされずに正しく解析できる「頑健性」を備えている
前後の時間のつながり（時系列コンテキスト）を考慮するため、単発の数値チェックでは見抜けない異常も検知できる
データセット全体の「品質スコア」を自動算出。膨大なセンサー群の中から、まずどこを点検すべきかの優先順位がつけられる
従来の統計的手法や深層学習モデルよりも高い精度で外れ値を特定でき、誤報や見落としを大幅に削減できる
who_should_read: PM/プロダクトマネージャー
application_ideas: 橋梁やトンネルのセンサー監視で、通信トラブルや機器故障による「偽の異常信号」を自動除去し、現場出向のコストを削減する。
工場の設備稼働データにおいて、突発的な電気ノイズを「無視すべきデータ」として自動処理し、高精度な予兆保全システムを実現する。
BIM/CIMにおける環境モニタリングデータの入力前処理として活用し、シミュレーション結果に悪影響を及ぼす「ゴミデータ」を事前にクリーニングする。

papers.title: 3D-LENS: A 3D Lifting-based Elevated Novel-view Synthesis method for Single-View Aerial-Ground Re-Identification
papers.abstract: Aerial-Ground Re-Identification (AG-ReID) is constrained by the viewpoint-domain gap, as drastic viewpoint disparities occlude or distort discriminative features, making cross-viewpoint image retrieval challenging. While existing methods rely on paired cross-view annotations, real-world deployments, such as wilderness search-and-rescue (SAR), often lack target-domain data, requiring retrieval from ground-level references alone. To our knowledge, we are the first to address this challenge by formalizing the Single-View AG-ReID (SV AG-ReID) setting, where models trained on a single real viewpoint must generalize to an unseen viewpoint. We propose 3D Lifting-based Elevated Novel-view Synthesis (3D-LENS), a unified framework combining geometrically-consistent novel view synthesis that leverages large-scale 3D mesh reconstruction, with a robust representation learning scheme to mitigate synthetic-to-real bias. Unlike 2D generative baselines that suffer from geometric inconsistencies or prior 3D methods that are restricted to class-specific templates, our approach ensures view-consistent synthesis across diverse categories without predefined templates that fail to capture fine-grained details, such as carried objects. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on SV AG-ReID scenarios. Code and data will be released at https://github.com/TurtleSmoke/3D-LENS.
papers.headline: 空撮と地上の「見え方の違い」を克服し対象を特定できる技術
papers.one_liner: ドローンなどの高い視点と地上の視点という、見え方が大きく異なる画像同士でも、3Dモデル化技術（3D空間での形状復元）を使って視点のズレを補正し、同一の人物や物体を正確に特定（再識別）できるようになります。
key_points: ドローン映像と地上カメラの「角度の差」による見落としや誤認識を大幅に減らせる
空と地上の両方の学習データが揃っていなくても、片方の視点データだけでAIの導入が可能
3D空間で形状を捉え直すため、従来のAI画像生成で起きがちだった「形が不自然に歪む」問題が起きにくい
特定の形（車や人）に依存せず、持ち物などの細かい特徴を維持したまま視点を変換できる
事前のデータ準備が難しい災害現場や広大な工事現場でも、即座に高度な捜索・管理ができる
who_should_read: PM/プロダクトマネージャー
application_ideas: 広大な建設現場で、ドローン空撮画像と作業員のスマホ写真を照合し、安全装備の着用確認や所在管理を自動化する。
橋梁やダムの点検において、遠方のドローン写真と近接撮影した損傷箇所の写真を紐付け、3Dモデル上の正確な位置に不具合を記録する。
大規模工場の資材置き場で、ドローンによる在庫把握とフォークリフトの車載カメラ映像を突き合わせ、物品の移動履歴を自動で追跡する。

papers.title: State Beyond Appearance: Diagnosing and Improving State Consistency in Dial-Based Measurement Reading
papers.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have achieved impressive progress on general multimodal tasks, yet they remain brittle on dial-based measurement reading. In this paper, we study this problem through controlled benchmarks and feature-space probing, and show that current MLLMs not only achieve unsatisfactory accuracy on dial-based readout, but also suffer sharp performance drops under viewpoint and illumination changes even when the underlying dial state remains fixed. Our probing analysis further reveals that same-state samples under appearance variation are not consistently clustered, while neighboring states fail to preserve the local structure implied by continuous dial values. These findings suggest that existing MLLMs largely ignore the intrinsic state geometry of dial measurement tasks and instead rely on superficial appearance cues. Motivated by this diagnosis, we propose TriSCA, a tri-level state-consistent alignment framework for dial-based measurement reading. Specifically, TriSCA consists of state-distance-aware representation alignment, metadata-grounded observation-to-state supervision, and state-aware objective alignment. Extensive ablation studies and evaluation experiments on controlled clock and gauge benchmarks, together with evaluation on an external real-world benchmark, demonstrate the effectiveness of our method.
papers.headline: 暗所や斜めからの撮影でも、メーターの数値を正確に読み取れる
papers.one_liner: 撮影角度や照明の変化に弱かったAI（画像もテキストも扱えるモデル）に対し、見た目ではなく「指針が指す値」そのものを一貫して理解させる新技術（TriSCA）です。
key_points: 斜めから撮影した計器写真でも、正面から見た時と同じ正確な数値を読み取れる
夜間や逆光、影の映り込みなど、現場の照明環境が悪くても読み取りミスが激減する
「見た目」が似ているだけの誤判定を防ぎ、メーターが示す「意味」を正しく把握できる
アナログ時計や圧力計など、円形の指針を持つ様々な計器に汎用的に対応できる
AIが数値の連続性を理解するため、わずかな針の動きも精密に検知できるようになる
who_should_read: PM/プロダクトマネージャー
application_ideas: 工場の巡回点検において、古いアナログ圧力計をスマホでサッと斜めから撮影しても、自動で台帳に正しい数値を記録でき、転記ミスの削減ができる。
橋梁やトンネルのひずみ計の確認において、足場が悪く正面から撮影できない場所でも、遠隔からズーム撮影した画像で正確な変位を把握できる。
プラントの計器室で、多種多様なメーカーのメーターが混在していても、照明の影響を排除して一貫した精度で異常検知の自動化ができる。

papers.title: Adaptive and Fine-grained Module-wise Expert Pruning for Efficient LoRA-MoE Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract: LoRA-MoE has emerged as an effective paradigm for parameter-efficient fine-tuning, combining the low training cost of LoRA with the increased adaptation capacity of Mixture-of-Experts (MoE). However, existing LoRA-MoE frameworks typically adopt a fixed and uniform expert configuration across heterogeneous Transformer modules (\eg, attention query/key projections and MLP gating networks), ignoring their distinct functional roles and capacity requirements. This design leads to localized over-provisioning, redundant trainable parameters, and unnecessary optimizer-state overhead. Moreover, prior methods enforce load balancing among experts throughout training. Although beneficial in the early stage, this constraint becomes restrictive once routing patterns stabilize, limiting expert specialization on downstream tasks. In this paper, we propose DMEP, a novel LoRA-MoE fine-tuning framework based on Dynamic Module-wise Expert Pruning. DMEP tracks expert utilization during training and physically removes low-utility experts on a per-module basis, yielding a more compact expert structure tailored to different modules. The pruned model then continues training without the load-balancing constraint, freeing the remaining experts to focus entirely on the downstream task and develop specialized expertise. By jointly adapting module-wise expert capacity and eliminating unnecessary balancing, DMEP improves both parameter efficiency and training efficiency. Extensive experiments on multiple reasoning benchmarks show that DMEP reduces trainable parameters by 35\%--43\% and improves training throughput by about 10\%, while maintaining or surpassing the downstream reasoning accuracy of uniform LoRA-MoE baselines.
papers.headline: AI学習を4割軽量化し、専門業務への適応力を高める
papers.one_liner: AIの部品ごとに「本当に必要な専門家（小規模な学習回路）」を自動で選別し、不要な部分を削ぎ落とすことで、少ない計算資源で特定の業務に強いAIを効率的に育てられます（自社データでの追加学習を効率化する技術）。
key_points: AIの内部にある「専門家」のムダを自動で見つけ、学習中にリアルタイムでリストラできる
学習に必要なパラメーター（AIの記憶容量のようなもの）を約4割削減し、安価なサーバーでも高性能なAI構築が可能になる
学習速度が約10%向上し、現場の最新データを取り込んだAIの更新サイクルを早められる
特定のタスクに特化した「深い専門知識」をAIが獲得しやすくなり、推論の精度が向上する
精度を維持したままモデルをスリム化できるため、将来的なシステム運用コストも低減できる
who_should_read: PM/プロダクトマネージャー
application_ideas: 図面チェックの場面で、法令、構造、設備などの項目ごとに最適な『専門頭脳』を自動構成するAIとして使えば、高精度な自動照査が低コストで実現できそう
工場の品質検査で、微細な傷の検知や色の異常など、異なるチェック項目を一つのモデルで効率よく学習させる際に使えば、検査端末の負荷を下げつつ精度を向上できそう
インフラ点検の報告書作成AIで、橋梁、トンネル、ダムといった施設ごとに最適な知識を効率的に学習させることで、現場ごとにカスタマイズされたAIを短期間で構築できそう

papers.title: Calibrated Surprise: An Information-Theoretic Account of Creative Quality
papers.abstract:
The essence of good creative writing is calibrated surprise: when constraints from all relevant dimensions act together, the feasible solution space collapses into a narrow region, and the surviving choices look least predictable from an unconstrained view. "Calibrated" has a precise meaning: the author's intent, the reader's reasonable expectation, and the logic of reality converge. When these three independent judgements agree on every dimension, the set of admissible writing choices is forced into a very small region. A mathematical corollary follows: full-dimensional accuracy and mediocrity are mutually exclusive -- two sides of one constraint structure, not separate goals.
  We use Shannon's mutual information $I(X;Y) = H(X) - H(X|Y)$ as our analysis tool. "Calibrated" corresponds to conditional entropy going to zero; "surprise" to entropy going up; mutual information is the precise measure of the joint quantity. The argument rests on two pillars. Static: when constraints from ethos, mythos, lexis, and dianoia are imposed together, the admissible set collapses sharply, and surviving solutions show up as low-probability choices from an unconstrained view. Dynamic: the chain rule shows each writing choice is constrained by what came before and constrains what comes after; macro-level decisions naturally contribute a larger share of information, removing the need for hand-tuned weighting.
  Through case studies and lightweight LLM-logprob computations, we show the framework is both analytically useful and operational, laying the theoretical groundwork for Creative Quality Alignment (CQA) and a professional evaluation benchmark.
papers.headline: 「ハッと驚くが納得感がある」文章をAIが作れるようになる
papers.one_liner: 文章の「面白さ」を、意外性（驚き）と論理的な正しさ（調整）のバランスとして数学的に定義し、AIが「凡庸（当たり障りない内容）」ではないプロ級の表現を選び取れるようにします。
key_points: 「意外だけど納得」というプロの技を数値で評価し、AIに再現させることができる
「当たり障りのない退屈な回答」と「デタラメな嘘（AIの思い込み）」の両方を同時に回避できる
法規・予算・構造などの「厳しいルール（制約）」を重ねるほど、AIが導き出す答えの質が逆に高まる
過去の文脈と将来の展開を数理モデルでつなぎ、長文でも論理が破綻しない一貫性を保てる
プロの品質基準（CQA）にAIを合わせるための評価指標として、客観的な数値（確率スコア）が使える
tags: クリエイティブ最適化
who_should_read: PM/プロダクトマネージャー
application_ideas: BIM設計支援：構造・法規・コストの制約をすべて満たした上で、人間の設計者が思いつかなかったような「合理的かつ斬新な空間配置」をAIに提案させる。
インフラ点検報告書：膨大なデータの中から、定型文ではないが論理的に導き出された「見落としがちな重要リスク」を、現場監督が納得できる形で抽出・要約する。
熟練工の暗黙知の解析：ベテランが下す「意外な判断（驚き）」を、周囲の状況や物理現象（制約）と紐づけて解析し、若手へ納得感のある指示を出す教育AIに活用する。

papers.title: Turning the TIDE: Cross-Architecture Distillation for Diffusion Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) offer parallel decoding and bidirectional context, but state-of-the-art dLLMs require billions of parameters for competitive performance. While existing distillation methods for dLLMs reduce inference steps within a single architecture, none address cross-architecture knowledge transfer, in which the teacher and student differ in architecture, attention mechanism, and tokenizer. We present TIDE, the first framework for cross-architecture dLLM distillation, comprising three modular components: (1) TIDAL, which jointly modulates distillation strength across training progress and diffusion timestep to account for the teacher's noise-dependent reliability; (2) CompDemo, which enriches the teacher's context via complementary mask splitting to improve predictions under heavy masking; and (3) Reverse CALM, a cross-tokenizer objective that inverts chunk-level likelihood matching, yielding bounded gradients and dual-end noise filtering. Distilling 8B dense and 16B MoE teachers into a 0.6B student via two heterogeneous pipelines outperforms the baseline by an average of 1.53 points across eight benchmarks, yielding notable gains in code generation, where HumanEval scores reach 48.78 compared to 32.3 for the AR baseline.
papers.headline: 巨大AIの賢さを軽量AIへ、型を超えて高速移植できる
papers.one_liner: 膨大な知識を持つ巨大なAI（教師）から、構造や文字の区切り方が異なる軽量なAI（生徒）へ効率的に知能を継承（蒸留）させる技術です。これにより、スマホや現場の端末で動く小型AIが、巨大AI並みの高度な判断力を備えられるようになります。
key_points: AIの「型」が違っても、その賢さ（推論能力）だけを抜き取って小型AIに移植できる。
一度にまとめて処理する「拡散モデル（dLLM）」を採用し、回答の待ち時間を大幅に短縮できる。
AIの「思い込み（ノイズ）」の段階に応じて教え方を変える仕組みにより、学習の効率が向上する。
文字の区切り方（トークナイザー）が異なるAI同士でも連携でき、既存の強力な巨大AIを自由に先生役に選べる。
プログラミングなどの複雑な作業で、従来の小型AIを1.5倍も上回る高い精度を発揮する。
tags: エッジコンピューティング
who_should_read: PM/プロダクトマネージャー
application_ideas: 図面チェックの現場で、クラウドに繋げないオフラインのタブレット上でも、巨大モデル級の精度で図面の不備を即座に見つける「ポータブル点検AI」として活用する。
インフラ点検中、通信環境の悪いトンネル内などで、小型AIが熟練工レベルの点検報告書の下書きをリアルタイムで生成し、事務作業をゼロにする。
工場の製造ラインの安価な制御チップに、巨大AIの判断基準を移植。複雑な異常予兆を、現場サーバーを介さずその場でミリ秒単位で検知し、ラインを自動調整する。

papers.title: From Mirage to Grounding: Towards Reliable Multimodal Circuit-to-Verilog Code Generation
papers.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly used to translate visual artifacts into code, from UI mockups into HTML to scientific plots into Python scripts. A circuit diagram can be viewed as a visual domain-specific language for hardware: it encodes timing, topology, and bit level semantics that are invisible to casual inspection yet safety critical once fabricated in silicon. Translating such diagrams into register-transfer-level(RTL) code therefore represents an extreme reliability test for vision-to-code generation. We reveal a phenomenon we call Mirage: replacing a circuit diagram with a blank image leaves Pass@k unchanged or even higher, because models bypass the visual input and instead exploit identifier semantics in the module header to retrieve canonical RTL templates. This constitutes a new, highly covert class of defect in AI-assisted code generation that directly undermines MLLMs' trustworthiness. To quantify the effect, we construct C2VEVAL and evaluate eight MLLMs under a paired Normal/Anony protocol in which Anony mode anonymizes all identifiers in both the diagram and the module header; Anony-mode scores drop sharply across all models, confirming that high Normal-mode accuracy is largely a Mirage. We then propose VeriGround (4B), trained with identifier anonymization, refusal augmentation, and D-ORPO (Decision-Focused ORPO) preference alignment that up-weights pivotal generate-or-refuse tokens. VeriGround achieves Functional Pass@1 of 46.11%/42.51%(Normal/Anony) with a False Refusal Rate of only 1.20%/0.00%, while maintaining >92% Refusal Rate on blank images. With only 4B parameters, VeriGround performs on par with GPT-5.4 under Normal and significantly outperforms all baselines under Anony, confirming genuine visual grounding.
papers.headline: 回路図を正しく「見て」設計コードを自動生成できるようになる
papers.one_liner: 画像とテキストを同時に理解できるAI（マルチモーダルLLM）が、図面の見た目から直接ハードウェア設計用のコード（Verilog）を生成します。AIがラベル名から中身を推測する「思い込み」を排除し、配線のつながりを正しく読み取る技術を確立しました。
key_points: 図面の名前やラベルに頼らず、配線のつながり（トポロジー）を視覚的に正しく理解できる
ラベルを隠した状態でも、図面の見た目だけで正確に設計コードを書き起こせる
白紙画像を入力しても「情報がない」と正しく判断し、適当な回答（でっち上げ）を防げる
40億パラメータという比較的小規模なAIで、最新の超巨大AI（GPT-4クラス）に匹敵する精度を実現
設計図の構造的な矛盾や、人為的なラベルの付け間違いに惑わされない信頼性を確保できる
who_should_read: PM/プロダクトマネージャー
application_ideas: 現場の「手書き配線図」のデジタル化：手書きのポンチ絵をスマホで撮るだけで、制御機器の初期設定コードやPLCプログラムの雛形を自動生成し、現場でのプログラミング工数を削減する。
古い設備の「文字が潰れた図面」の解析：ラベルが読み取れない古いインフラや工場の設備図面において、配線のつながりだけから現在のシステム構成を推定し、リプレース計画の策定を支援する。
工程フロー図からのシミュレーション自動構築：工場の生産ラインの工程図を読み取り、物理的な接続関係に基づいたシミュレーション用モデルを自動生成することで、ライン改善の試行錯誤を高速化する。

papers.title: Iterative Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Medical Question Answering
papers.abstract: Medical retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems typically operate on text chunks extracted from biomedical literature, discarding the rich visual content (tables, figures, structured layouts) of original document pages. We propose MED-VRAG, an iterative multimodal RAG framework that retrieves and reasons over PMC document page images instead of OCR'd text. The system pairs ColQwen2.5 patch-level page embeddings with a sharded MapReduce LLM filter, scaling to ~350K pages while keeping Stage-1 retrieval under 30 ms via an offline coarse-to-fine index (C=8 centroids per page, ANN over centroids, exact two-way scoring on the top-R shortlist). A vision-language model (VLM) then iteratively refines its query and accumulates evidence in a memory bank across up to 3 reasoning rounds, with a single iteration costing ~15.9 s and the full three-round pipeline ~47.8 s on 4xA100. Across four medical QA benchmarks (MedQA, MedMCQA, PubMedQA, MMLU-Med), MEDVRAG reaches 78.6% average accuracy. Under controlled comparison with the same Qwen2.5-VL-32B backbone, retrieval contributes a +5.8 point gain over the no-retrieval baseline; we also note a +1.8 point edge over MedRAG + GPT-4 (76.8%), with the caveat that this is a cross-paper rather than head-to-head comparison. Ablations isolate +1.0 from page-image vs text-chunk retrieval, +1.5 from iteration, and +1.0 from the memory bank.
papers.headline: 図表入りの専門文書をAIが画像として正確に読み解けるようになる
papers.one_liner: 文字データだけでなく図表やレイアウトを含む「ページ画像」をそのまま検索・解析（マルチモーダルRAG）することで、AIが専門的な質問に答えられる仕組みです。一度の回答で終わらず、AIが自ら調べ直して情報を整理する（反復推論）ことで、高度な専門知識を必要とする回答の精度を高めています。
key_points: 文字の書き起こし（OCR）が不要になり、図や表のレイアウト情報を維持したまま情報を検索できる
35万ページという膨大な資料の中から、わずか0.03秒という瞬速で必要な箇所を特定できる
一度の検索で確信が持てない場合、AIが「次は何を調べるべきか」を自ら判断して調べ直すため、見落としが減る
過去の検索結果を記憶しておく機能（メモリバンク）により、複数の情報を組み合わせた複雑な推論ができる
従来の文字だけを頼りにするAIよりも高い正答率を達成しており、専門性の高い実務への応用が期待できる
who_should_read: 図面認識・照査AIエンジニア
PM/プロダクトマネージャー
application_ideas: 橋梁の点検報告書の場面で、過去の図面や損傷写真が混在するページを画像として検索・分析することで、文字だけでは判断しにくい「補修履歴の連続性」を考慮した診断支援に活用できそう。
工場設備のトラブルシューティングの場面で、配線図や回路図の画像をそのままAIに参照させれば、マニュアルのテキスト検索では見つけられない「図中の部品の接続関係」に基づいた原因特定が自動化できそう。
建築確認申請の図面チェックの場面で、条文の文字情報と解説図の画像をセットで検索・照合させることで、法規制の解釈ミス（AIの思い込み）を減らし、適合性判定の精度を向上できそう。

papers.title: PRISM: Pre-alignment via Black-box On-policy Distillation for Multimodal Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: The standard post-training recipe for large multimodal models (LMMs) applies supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on curated demonstrations followed by reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). However, SFT introduces distributional drift that neither preserves the model's original capabilities nor faithfully matches the supervision distribution. This problem is further amplified in multimodal reasoning, where perception errors and reasoning failures follow distinct drift patterns that compound during subsequent RL. We introduce PRISM, a three-stage pipeline that mitigates this drift by inserting an explicit distribution-alignment stage between SFT and RLVR. Building on the principle of on-policy distillation (OPD), PRISM casts alignment as a black-box, response-level adversarial game between the policy and a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) discriminator with dedicated perception and reasoning experts, providing disentangled corrective signals that steer the policy toward the supervision distribution without requiring access to teacher logits. While 1.26M public demonstrations suffice for broad SFT initialization, distribution alignment demands higher-fidelity supervision; we therefore curate 113K additional demonstrations from Gemini 3 Flash, featuring dense visual grounding and step-by-step reasoning on the hardest unsolved problems. Experiments on Qwen3-VL show that PRISM consistently improves downstream RLVR performance across multiple RL algorithms (GRPO, DAPO, GSPO) and diverse multimodal benchmarks, improving average accuracy by +4.4 and +6.0 points over the SFT-to-RLVR baseline on 4B and 8B, respectively. Our code, data, and model checkpoints are publicly available at https://github.com/XIAO4579/PRISM.
papers.headline: AIの見間違いと思考のズレを修正し、判断の精度を大幅に高める
papers.one_liner: 画像と文字を同時に扱うAIが、学習中に陥りやすい「見落とし」や「理屈の破綻」を、お手本AIとの対話を通じて自動で修正する技術です。これにより、現場での複雑な判断が必要なタスクでの正解率（AIの回答の正確さ）を向上させます。
key_points: 画像認識のミスと、論理的な考え方のミスの両方を、個別の専門家AIが別々にチェックして正してくれる。
お手本となる高性能AI（Geminiなど）の内部データは不要で、回答内容だけで学習を軌道修正できる。
難しい問題に特化した高品質な学習データ（約11万件）により、AIが苦手とする「粘り強い推論」が身に付く。
強化学習（AIの試行錯誤による学習）の前にこの調整を挟むことで、最終的なAIの賢さが最大6ポイント向上する。
40億〜80億パラメータの中規模なAIモデルでも、より巨大なモデルに匹敵する高度な判断が可能になる。
who_should_read: PM/プロダクトマネージャー
application_ideas: 図面と仕様書の照合において、図面のシンボルを「正しく見ているか」と、基準に照らして「正しく判断しているか」を個別に最適化し、チェック漏れを激減させる。
インフラ点検の画像診断で、ひび割れの「見落とし」と、その原因となる「劣化メカニズムの推定」の両方の精度を上げ、ベテラン技術者に近い診断報告書を自動生成する。
工場での複雑な組み立て工程の動画解析において、作業ミス（画像上の変化）と手順の入れ替わり（論理的なミス）を切り分けて検知し、指導の的確性を向上させる。

papers.title: Learning-Based Hierarchical Scene Graph Matching for Robot Localization Leveraging Prior Maps
papers.abstract: Accurate localization is a fundamental requirement for autonomous robots operating in indoor environments. Scene graphs encode the spatial structure of an environment as a hierarchy of semantic entities and their relationships, and can be constructed both online from robot sensor data and offline from architectural priors such as Building Information Models (BIM). Matching these two complementary representations enables drift correction in SLAM by grounding robot observations against a known structural prior. However, establishing reliable node-to-node correspondences between them remains an open challenge: existing combinatorial methods are prohibitively expensive at scale, and prior learned approaches address only flat graph matching, ignoring the multi-level semantic structure present in both representations. Here we present a learned, end-to-end differentiable pipeline that augments both graphs with semantically motivated edge types encoding intra- and inter- level relationships, explicitly exploiting this hierarchy to enable simultaneous matching from high-level room concepts down to low-level wall surfaces. Trained exclusively on floor plans, the proposed method outperforms the combinatorial baseline in F1 on real LiDAR environments while running an order of magnitude faster, demonstrating viable zero-shot generalization for BIM-assisted robot localization.
papers.headline: BIMとロボットの視界を瞬時に照合し、現在地を正確に特定
papers.one_liner: ロボットが今見ている景色と建物の設計図（BIM）を、「部屋から壁へ」という階層構造で高速に照らし合わせ、自分の位置を正確に把握する技術です。AIが構造のつながりを理解することで、従来の10倍の速さで照合が可能になりました。
key_points: 設計図（BIM）をそのままロボットの「地図」として活用できるため、事前の現場測量の手間が省ける
「部屋→壁」という階層で整理して考えるため、広大な建物内でも迷わず高速に照合できる
きれいな図面で学習したAIが、ノイズの多い現場のセンサーデータ（点群）を正しく認識できる
計算量が大幅に削減されており、ロボットが動きながらリアルタイムで位置補正を行える

papers.title: Agent-Agnostic Evaluation of SQL Accuracy in Production Text-to-SQL Systems
papers.abstract: Text-to-SQL (T2SQL) evaluation in production environments poses fundamental challenges that existing benchmarks do not address. Current evaluation methodologies whether rule-based SQL matching or schema-dependent semantic parsers assume access to ground-truth queries and structured database schema, constraints that are rarely satisfied in real-world deployments. This disconnect leaves production T2SQL agents largely unevaluated beyond developer-time testing, creating silent quality degradation with no feedback mechanism for continuous improvement. We present STEF (Schema-agnostic Text-to-SQL Evaluation Framework), a production-native evaluation system that operates exclusively on natural language inputs the user question, an enriched reformulation, and the generated SQL without requiring database schema or reference queries. STEF extracts semantic specifications from both natural language and SQL representations, performs normalized feature alignment, and produces an interpretable 0 to 100 accuracy score via a composite metric that encompasses filter alignment, semantic verdict, and confidence of the evaluator. Key contributions include: enriched question quality validation as a first-class evaluation signal, configurable application-specific rule injection via prompt templating, and production-robust normalization handling GROUP BY tolerance, ORDER BY defaults, and LIMIT heuristics. Empirical results demonstrate that STEF enables continuous production monitoring and agent improvement feedback loops without schema dependency, making structured query evaluation viable at scale for the first time.
papers.headline: 正解データなしで、AIのデータ抽出ミスを自動検知できる
papers.one_liner: 言葉での指示をデータベース操作言語（SQL）に変換するAIの性能を、正解データや設計図（スキーマ）なしで評価できる仕組みです。AIが「ユーザーの意図を正しく読み取ってコードを書いたか」を、言葉の意味の重なりから自動判定（セマンティック・アライメント）します。

papers.title: WindowsWorld: A Process-Centric Benchmark of Autonomous GUI Agents in Professional Cross-Application Environments
papers.abstract: While GUI agents have shown impressive capabilities in common computer-use tasks such as OSWorld, current benchmarks mainly focus on isolated and single-application tasks. This overlooks a critical real-world requirement of coordinating across multiple applications to accomplish complex profession-specific workflows. To bridge this gap, we present a computer-use benchmark in cross-application workflows, named WindowsWorld, designed to systematically assess GUI Agents on complex multi-step tasks that mirror real-world professional activities. Our methodology uses a multi-agent framework steered by 16 occupations to generate four difficulty-level tasks with intermediate inspection, which are then refined by human review and executed in a simulated environment. The resulting benchmark contains 181 tasks with an average of 5.0 sub-goals across 17 common desktop applications, of which 78% are inherently multi-application. Experimental results of leading large models and agents show that: 1) All computer-use agents perform poorly on multi-application tasks (< 21% success rate), far below the performance of simple single-app tasks; 2) They largely fail at tasks requiring conditional judgment and reasoning across $\geq$ 3 applications, stalling at early sub-goals; 3) Low execution efficiency, where tasks often fail despite far exceeding human step limits. Code, benchmark data, and evaluation resources are available at github.com/HITsz-TMG/WindowsWorld.
papers.headline: AIが複数のソフトを横断して「一連の仕事」を完結できるようになる
papers.one_liner: メール、Excel、専用ソフトなどを使い分けて複雑な業務をこなす「PC操作AI」の能力を厳しく判定するテスト指標（ベンチマーク）が開発されました。これにより、単一のアプリ操作に留まらない、より実務に近いAIの自動化能力が測定可能になります。
key_points: 複数のアプリをまたぐ「本当のプロの仕事」をAIがどこまでこなせるか数値化できる

papers.title: LaST-R1: Reinforcing Action via Adaptive Physical Latent Reasoning for VLA Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have increasingly incorporated reasoning mechanisms for complex robotic manipulation. However, existing approaches share a critical limitation: whether employing explicit linguistic reasoning that suffers from latency and discretization, or utilizing more expressive continuous latent reasoning, they are predominantly confined to static imitation learning that limits adaptability and generalization. While online reinforcement learning (RL) has been introduced to VLAs to enable trial-and-error exploration, current methods exclusively optimize the vanilla action space, bypassing the underlying physical reasoning process. In this paper, we present \textbf{LaST-R1}, a unified VLA framework that integrates latent Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning over physical dynamics prior to action execution, along with a tailored RL post-training paradigm. Specifically, we propose \textbf{Latent-to-Action Policy Optimization (LAPO)}, a novel RL algorithm that jointly optimizes the latent reasoning process and the action generation. By bridging reasoning and control, LAPO improves the representation of physical world modeling and enhances robustness in interactive environments. Furthermore, an \textbf{adaptive latent CoT mechanism} is introduced to allow the policy to dynamically adjust its reasoning horizon based on environment complexity. Extensive experiments show that LaST-R1 achieves a near-perfect 99.8\% average success rate on the LIBERO benchmark with only one-shot supervised warm-up, significantly improving convergence speed and performance over prior state-of-the-art methods. In real-world deployments, LAPO post-training yields up to a 44\% improvement over the initial warm-up policy across four complex tasks, including both single-arm and dual-arm settings. Finally, LaST-R1 demonstrates strong generalization across simulated and real-world environments.
papers.headline: ロボットが「物理を考えて動く」ことで複雑な作業の成功率が劇的に向上
papers.one_liner: ロボットが言葉を使わずに「物理的な動きの予測」を頭の中でシミュレーション（潜在的な推論）し、試行錯誤を通じて自ら学習（強化学習）することで、複雑な動作をより正確かつ柔軟に実行できる技術です。

papers.title: Claw-Eval-Live: A Live Agent Benchmark for Evolving Real-World Workflows
papers.abstract: LLM agents are expected to complete end-to-end units of work across software tools, business services, and local workspaces. Yet many agent benchmarks freeze a curated task set at release time and grade mainly the final response, making it difficult to evaluate agents against evolving workflow demand or verify whether a task was executed. We introduce Claw-Eval-Live, a live benchmark for workflow agents that separates a refreshable signal layer, updated across releases from public workflow-demand signals, from a reproducible, time-stamped release snapshot. Each release is constructed from public workflow-demand signals, with ClawHub Top-500 skills used in the current release, and materialized as controlled tasks with fixed fixtures, services, workspaces, and graders. For grading, Claw-Eval-Live records execution traces, audit logs, service state, and post-run workspace artifacts, using deterministic checks when evidence is sufficient and structured LLM judging only for semantic dimensions. The release contains 105 tasks spanning controlled business services and local workspace repair, and evaluates 13 frontier models under a shared public pass rule. Experiments reveal that reliable workflow automation remains far from solved: the leading model passes only 66.7% of tasks and no model reaches 70%. Failures are structured by task family and execution surface, with HR, management, and multi-system business workflows as persistent bottlenecks and local workspace repair comparatively easier but unsaturated. Leaderboard rank alone is insufficient because models with similar pass rates can diverge in overall completion, and task-level discrimination concentrates in a middle band of tasks. Claw-Eval-Live suggests that workflow-agent evaluation should be grounded twice, in fresh external demand and in verifiable agent action.
papers.headline: AIが仕事を完遂できるかを、実務レベルで厳密に採点する

papers.title: Parameter-Efficient Architectural Modifications for Translation-Invariant CNNs
papers.abstract: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) are widely assumed to be translation-invariant, yet standard architectures exhibit a startling fragility: even a single-pixel shift can drastically degrade performance due to their reliance on spatially dependent fully connected layers. In this work, we resolve this vulnerability by proposing a lightweight 'Online Architecture' strategy. By strategically inserting Global Average Pooling (GAP) layers at various network depths, we effectively decouple feature recognition from spatial location. Using VGG-16 as a primary case study, we demonstrate that this architectural modification achieves a massive 98% reduction in trainable parameters (from 5.2M to just 82K) and a 90% reduction in total network size (138M to 14M). Despite this drastic pruning, our variants maintain competitive Top-1 accuracy on ImageNet (66.4%) while doubling translational robustness, reducing average relative loss from 0.09 to 0.05. Furthermore, our analysis identifies a fundamental limit to invariance: while GAP resolves macroscopic sensitivity, discrete pooling operations introduce a residual periodic aliasing that prevents perfect pixel-level stability. Finally, we extend these findings to Perceptual Image Quality Assessment (IQA) by integrating our invariant backbones into the LPIPS framework. The resulting metric significantly outperforms the retrained baseline in generalization across the KADID-10k dataset (Spearman 0.89 vs. 0.75) and achieves a near-perfect alignment with human psychophysical response curves on the RAID dataset (Spearman 0.95). These results confirm that enforcing architectural invariance is a far more efficient and biologically plausible path to robustness than traditional data augmentation. Data and code are publicly available. The data and code are publicly available to facilitate validation and further research.
papers.headline: 画像のズレに強く、AIを10分の1に軽量化できる

papers.title: Robust Lightweight Crack Classification for Real-Time UAV Bridge Inspection
papers.abstract: With the widespread application of Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) in bridge structural health monitoring, deep learning-based automatic crack detection has become a major research focus. However, practical UAV inspections still face four key challenges: weak crack features, degraded imaging conditions, severe class imbalance, and limited computational resources for practical UAV inspection workflows. To address these issues, this paper proposes a unified lightweight convolutional neural network framework composed of four synergistic components: a lightweight backbone network, a Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM) for channel and spatial enhancement, a directed robust augmentation strategy based on inspection-scene priors, and Focal Loss for hard-sample learning under class imbalance. Experiments on the SDNET2018 bridge deck dataset show that the proposed method achieves an inference speed of 825 FPS with only 11.21M parameters and 1.82G FLOPs. Compared with the baseline model, the complete framework improves the F1-score by 2.51% and recall by 3.95%. In addition, Grad-CAM visualizations indicate that the introduced attention module shifts the model's focus from scattered regions to precise tracking along crack trajectories. Overall, this study achieves a strong balance among accuracy, speed, and robustness, providing a practical solution for ground-station assisted real-time deployment in UAV bridge inspections. The source code is available at: https://github.com/skylynf/AttXNet .
papers.headline: ドローンで橋のひび割れをリアルタイムに自動判定
papers.one_liner: ドローンが撮影する映像から、橋のひび割れを1秒間に800枚以上の超高速で自動判別する技術です。AIに「どこを見るべきか」を教え込む仕組み（アテンション機構）と、現場特有の悪条件を想定した訓練（データ拡張）により、安価な装置でも正確な点検を可能にします。

papers.title: ObjectGraph: From Document Injection to Knowledge Traversal -- A Native File Format for the Agentic Era
papers.abstract:
Every document format in existence was designed for a human reader moving linearly through text. Autonomous LLM agents do not read - they retrieve. This fundamental mismatch forces agents to inject entire documents into their context window, wasting tokens on irrelevant content, compounding state across multi-turn loops, and broadcasting information indiscriminately across agent roles. We argue this is not a prompt engineering problem, not a retrieval problem, and not a compression problem: it is a format problem.
  We introduce OBJECTGRAPH (.og), a file format that reconceives the document as a typed, directed knowledge graph to be traversed rather than a string to be injected. OBJECTGRAPH is a strict superset of Markdown - every .md file is a valid .og file - requires no infrastructure beyond a two-primitive query protocol, and is readable by both humans and agents without tooling.
  We formalize the Document Consumption Problem, characterise six structural properties no existing format satisfies simultaneously, and prove OBJECTGRAPH satisfies all six. We further introduce the Progressive Disclosure Model, the Role-Scoped Access Protocol, and Executable Assertion Nodes as native format primitives. Empirical evaluation across five document classes and eight agent task types demonstrates up to 95.3 percent token reduction with no statistically significant degradation in task accuracy (p > 0.05). Transpiler fidelity reaches 98.7 percent content preservation on a held-out document benchmark.
papers.headline: 文書を「地図」に変えて、AIの通信コストを9割削減する新技術
papers.one_liner: 人間が読むための「長い文章」を、AIが迷わず必要な場所だけを辿れる「情報の地図（知識グラフ）」形式へ変換します。これにより、AIが大量の文書を読み込む際の手間とコストを大幅に省きつつ、正確な回答を引き出せるようになります。
key_points: AIが読む必要のない部分をスキップし、利用料（トークン消費）を最大95%削減できる

文書内に「自動チェック機能」を埋め込み、AIの勝手な思い込み（でっち上げ）をその場で検証できる

papers.title: GourNet: A CNN-Based Model for Mango Leaf Disease Detection
papers.abstract: Mango cultivation is crucial in the agricultural sector, significantly contributing to economic development and food security. However, diseases affecting mango leaves can significantly reduce both the production and overall fruit grade. Detecting leaf diseases at an early stage with precision is key to effective disease prevention and sustaining crop productivity. In this paper, we introduce a "deep learning" model named "GourNet", which leverages "Convolutional Neural Networks" to identify infections in mango leaves. We utilize the "MangoLeafBD" (MBD) dataset to train and assess the effectiveness of the presented model. The MBD dataset contains seven disease classes and a Healthy class, making a total of eight classes. To enhance model performance, the images are preprocessed through steps like resizing, rescaling, and data augmentation prior to training. To properly evaluate the model, the dataset is separated into 80% for training, with the remaining 20% equally split between validation and testing. Our model uses only 683,656 total parameters and achieves a classification accuracy of 97%. This research's source code can be found at: https://github.com/ekramalam/GourNet-Repo.
papers.headline: マンゴーの病気を葉っぱ1枚からAIが97%の精度で見抜く
papers.one_liner: マンゴーの葉の画像から、7種類の病気と健康状態を97%の高精度で自動判別できるAI（GourNet）が開発されました。複雑な計算を抑えた「軽量な設計（少ないパラメータ）」により、現場の端末でもスムーズに動作するのが特徴です。
key_points: 画像1枚で病気の種類を特定でき、深刻化する前の早期対策が可能になる
97%という極めて高い精度で、熟練者の「目利き」を自動化できる
AIの脳の複雑さ（パラメータ数）を約68万個と非常に小さく抑えており、高性能なサーバーがなくてもスマホ等で動かしやすい
撮影条件のバラつきに強い学習手法（データ拡張）を採用しており、現場での実用性が高い
ソースコードが公開されているため、特定の植物や製品に合わせたカスタマイズの土台として活用できる
who_should_read: PM/プロダクトマネージャー
application_ideas: インフラ点検の場面で、スマホで撮影した錆（さび）やコンクリートのひび割れを、現場で即座に「修繕が必要なレベルか」判別するツールとして使えば、点検作業の一次切り分けを自動化できる。
工場の製造ラインにおいて、部品の小さな傷や凹みを低スペックな小型カメラ端末だけでリアルタイムに仕分ける検品アシストとして使えば、高価な機材を揃えずに検査の自動化が進められる。
建設現場の安全管理で、作業員のヘルメットや安全帯の着用不備をその場で検知するエッジデバイス（現場設置のカメラ）として使えば、通信遅延なしに警告を出せる。

papers.title: MM-StanceDet: Retrieval-Augmented Multi-modal Multi-agent Stance Detection
papers.abstract: Multimodal Stance Detection (MSD) is crucial for understanding public discourse, yet effectively fusing text and image, especially with conflicting signals, remains challenging. Existing methods often face difficulties with contextual grounding, cross-modal interpretation ambiguity, and single-pass reasoning fragility. To address these, we propose Retrieval-Augmented Multi-modal Multi-agent Stance Detection (MM-StanceDet), a novel multi-agent framework integrating Retrieval Augmentation for contextual grounding, specialized Multimodal Analysis agents for nuanced interpretation, a Reasoning-Enhanced Debate stage for exploring perspectives, and Self-Reflection for robust adjudication. Extensive experiments on five datasets demonstrate MM-StanceDet significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, validating the efficacy of its multi-agent architecture and structured reasoning stages in addressing complex multimodal stance challenges.
papers.headline: 文字と画像がバラバラでもAIが「真意」を正しく見抜けるようになる
papers.one_liner: 画像と文章の内容が矛盾していても、外部情報を検索（RAG）して補いつつ、複数のAIが議論を交わすことで、投稿者の「本音（スタンス）」を正確に判定する技術です。
key_points: 画像とテキストの「食い違い」や「皮肉」も、複数のAIによる議論で見抜ける
外部知識を自ら調べることで、AIの「思い込み（ハルシネーション）」を最小限に抑えられる
一つの視点に固執せず、複数のAIが異なる角度から分析するため、判断の偏りが減る
AIが自身の出した結論を最後に見直す「自己点検（セルフリフレクション）」により、回答の信頼性が向上する
複雑な社会背景やトレンドが絡む投稿でも、人間のように文脈を汲み取った分析ができる
who_should_read: PM/プロダクトマネージャー
application_ideas: 建設現場の「施工写真」と「日報（テキスト）」を照合し、内容に矛盾や虚偽がないかを自動でチェックする検品ツール。
SNS上の自社製品に対する口コミから、写真とコメントのニュアンスの違い（皮肉なのか絶賛なのか）を正しく仕分け、真の顧客満足度を可視化する。
インフラ点検において、過去の点検履歴（テキスト）と現在の損傷写真（画像）を比較し、これまでの経緯と矛盾する判定をAI同士に議論させて特定する。

papers.title: AEGIS: A Holistic Benchmark for Evaluating Forensic Analysis of AI-Generated Academic Images
papers.abstract: We introduce AEGIS, A holistic benchmark for Evaluating forensic analysis of AI-Generated academic ImageS. Compared to existing benchmarks, AEGIS features three key advances: (1) Domain-Specific Complexity: covering seven academic categories with 39 fine-grained subtypes, exposing intrinsic forensic difficulty, where even GPT-5.1 reaches 48.80% overall performance and expert models achieve only limited localization accuracy (IoU 30.09%); (2) Diverse Forgery Simulations: modeling four prevalent academic forgery strategies across 25 generative models, with 11 yielding average forensic accuracy below 50%, showing that forensics lag behind generative advances; and (3) Multi-Dimensional Forensic Evaluation: jointly assessing detection, reasoning, and localization, revealing complementary strengths between model families, with multimodal large language models (MLLMs) at 84.74% accuracy in textual artifact recognition and expert detectors peaking at 79.54% accuracy in binary authenticity detection. By evaluating 25 leading MLLMs, nine expert models, and one unified multimodal understanding and generation model, AEGIS serves as a diagnostic testbed exposing fundamental limitations in academic image forensics.
papers.headline: 巧妙な「AI製の偽画像」を見破り、不自然な箇所を特定できる
papers.one_liner: 論文や技術資料の図表がAIで作られた「捏造（ねつぞう）」かどうかを判定し、どこが、なぜ怪しいのかを解説・特定する評価手法（ベンチマーク）です。
key_points: 高度に加工された「偽の図表」でも、AIが「本物か偽物か」を高い精度で判定できる
「なぜ偽物と判断したか」の根拠を言葉で説明できるため、人間が判断ミスを防げる
画像のどの範囲が改ざんされたのか、不自然なエリアをピンポイントで特定できる
最新のAIで作られた「人間には見分けがつかない画像」の弱点を突いて検知できる
グラフや医学画像、専門図版など、複雑なデータの信頼性を自動でチェックできる
who_should_read: PM/プロダクトマネージャー
application_ideas: 「工事現場の進捗写真」の改ざんチェック。AIで作業員を消したり資材を増やしたりした偽装を見抜き、報告書の信頼性を担保する。
「インフラ点検の損傷報告」の真実性検証。過去のひび割れ画像を加工して現在の報告書に使い回していないか、AIが不自然な加工跡を解析する。
「品質検査の証拠画像」の自動照査。検査データをグラフ化した画像が、実データに基づかずAIで「それっぽく」生成されたものでないかを監視する。

papers.title: 3D Reconstruction Techniques in the Manufacturing Domain: Applications, Research Opportunities and Use Cases
papers.abstract: This comprehensive review examines the evolution and the current state of the art in three-dimensional (3D) reconstruction techniques in manufacturing applications. The analysis covers both traditional approaches and emerging deep learning methods, showing a critical research gap in unified 3d reconstruction frameworks. Through systematic review of 106 recent publications, we classify reconstruction techniques into three primary categories: data acquisition, point cloud generation, post-processing and applications. Non-contact methods, particularly structured light scanning and stereo vision, have shown significant adoption in manufacturing, with 47% of surveyed applications focusing on quality inspection. The integration of deep learning has enhanced reconstruction accuracy and processing speed, particularly in feature extraction and matching. Key applications span design and development (13%), machining (8%), process (17%), assembly (22%), and quality inspection (40%). While current technologies achieve sub-millimeter accuracy in controlled environments, challenges persist in handling reflective surfaces and dynamic environments. Our findings indicate a trend toward hybrid systems combining multiple sensor types and processing methods to overcome individual limitations. This survey provides a structured framework for understanding current capabilities and future directions in manufacturing-focused 3D reconstruction.
papers.headline: 工場の「目」をデジタル化し、0.1mm単位の自動検査を実現する
papers.one_liner: 最新のAIと3Dスキャン技術を組み合わせ、製品の形を精密な立体データ（点群データ：点の集合体で作る3D図）として再現し、傷やズレを自動で見つける仕組みです。
key_points: 熟練者の「目視」に頼っていた品質検査を、0.1mm単位の精度で機械的に自動化できる
最新のAI（ディープラーニング）により、複雑な形状の部品でも特徴を素早く正確に捉えられる
部品の組み立てミスをリアルタイムで検知し、後工程での大きな手戻りを防げる
複数のセンサーを組み合わせる手法により、AIが苦手な「光る金属」の測定ミスも克服できる
設計データと実物を3D上で直接比較できるため、試作から量産までのスピードが劇的に向上する
who_should_read: PM/プロダクトマネージャー
application_ideas: 自動車部品の製造ラインにおいて、非接触スキャナとAIを組み合わせて、微細な歪みやバリを数秒で全数検査するシステム
複雑な配管が入り組むプラント建設現場で、実物の設置状況を3Dスキャンし、BIM（設計データ）とのズレを自動抽出して施工ミスを早期発見する
ロボットアームに3Dカメラを搭載し、バラ積みされた部品の形状を瞬時に認識して、最適な角度でピッキング・組み立てを行う自動化セル

papers.title: MCPHunt: An Evaluation Framework for Cross-Boundary Data Propagation in Multi-Server MCP Agents
papers.abstract: Multi-server MCP agents create an information-flow control problem: faithful tool composition can turn individually benign read/write permissions into cross-boundary credential propagation -- a structural side effect of workflow topology, not necessarily malicious model behavior. We present MCPHunt, to our knowledge the first controlled benchmark that isolates non-adversarial, verbatim credential propagation across multi-server MCP trust boundaries, with three methodological contributions: (1) canary-based taint tracking that reduces propagation detection to objective string matching; (2) an environment-controlled coverage design with risky, benign, and hard-negative conditions that validates pipeline soundness and controls for credential-format confounds; (3) CRS stratification that disentangles task-mandated propagation (faithful execution of verbatim-transfer instructions) from policy-violating propagation (credentials included despite the option to redact). Across 3,615 main-benchmark traces from 5 models spanning 147 tasks and 9 mechanism families, policy-violating propagation rates reach 11.5--41.3% across all models. This propagation is pathway-specific (25x cross-mechanism range) and concentrated in browser-mediated data flows; hard-negative controls provide evidence that production-format credentials are not necessary -- prompt-directed cross-boundary data flow is sufficient. A prompt-mitigation study across 3 models reduces policy-violating propagation by up to 97% while preserving 80.5% utility, but effectiveness varies with instruction-following capability -- suggesting that prompt-level defenses alone may not suffice. Code, traces, and labeling pipeline are released under MIT and CC BY 4.0.
papers.headline: AI連携での「重要情報のうっかり漏えい」を自動検知できる
papers.one_liner: 複数のツールを使い分けるAI（マルチサーバーMCP）が、パスワードなどの認証情報を本来送るべきでない場所へ漏らしてしまうリスクを、専用のテスト環境（MCPHunt）で正確に診断できます。
key_points: AIが良かれと思って、あるツールのログイン情報を別のツールに渡してしまうミスを特定できる
「指示された通りに動いているだけ」で発生する、悪意のない情報漏えいの仕組みが分かる
ブラウザを介したデータ処理において、特に情報が漏れやすい弱点を発見できる
プロンプト（AIへの指示出し）の工夫により、利便性を保ちつつ漏えい率を最大97%削減できる
自社のAIシステムが「安全にツールを使い分けられているか」を客観的な指標で評価できる
who_should_read: PM/プロダクトマネージャー
application_ideas: 工場内の設備管理AIにおいて、特定のセンサーへのアクセス権限（認証情報）が、外部の解析レポート作成ツールに誤って送信されないか自動チェックする。
BIM/CIMの設計データをクラウドのレンダリングサービスへ送る際、プロジェクト全体の秘匿パスワードが紛れ込んでいないか診断ツールとして導入する。
インフラ点検で行政の非公開サーバーへ接続するAIエージェントが、一般公開用の報告書作成時にアクセスキーを「うっかり」記述しないか監視・防御する。

papers.title: From Unstructured Recall to Schema-Grounded Memory: Reliable AI Memory via Iterative, Schema-Aware Extraction
papers.abstract:
Persistent AI memory is often reduced to a retrieval problem: store prior interactions as text, embed them, and ask the model to recover relevant context later. This design is useful for thematic recall, but it is mismatched to the kinds of memory that agents need in production: exact facts, current state, updates and deletions, aggregation, relations, negative queries, and explicit unknowns. These operations require memory to behave less like search and more like a system of record.
  This paper argues that reliable external AI memory must be schema-grounded. Schemas define what must be remembered, what may be ignored, and which values must never be inferred. We present an iterative, schema-aware write path that decomposes memory ingestion into object detection, field detection, and field-value extraction, with validation gates, local retries, and stateful prompt control. The result shifts interpretation from the read path to the write path: reads become constrained queries over verified records rather than repeated inference over retrieved prose.
  We evaluate this design on structured extraction and end-to-end memory benchmarks. On the extraction benchmark, the judge-in-the-loop configuration reaches 90.42% object-level accuracy and 62.67% output accuracy, above all tested frontier structured-output baselines. On our end-to-end memory benchmark, xmemory reaches 97.10% F1, compared with 80.16%-87.24% across the third-party baselines. On the application-level task, xmemory reaches 95.2% accuracy, outperforming specialised memory systems, code-generated Markdown harnesses, and customer-facing frontier-model application harnesses. The results show that, for memory workloads requiring stable facts and stateful computation, architecture matters more than retrieval scale or model strength alone.
papers.headline: AIが事実を正確に記録・更新し、業務の信頼性を劇的に高める
papers.one_liner: AIが過去の情報を曖昧な文章としてではなく、あらかじめ定義した表形式（スキーマ）で整理して保存する仕組みです。情報の書き換えや数値の集計を「データベース」のように正確に行えるようになります。
key_points: 「情報の更新や削除」が確実に行えるため、古いデータに基づいたAIの誤回答を防げる
膨大な履歴の中から数値の合計や比較をミスなく算出でき、集計業務の自動化に強い
AIの「もっともらしい嘘（思い込み）」を保存時のチェック機能で未然に排除できる
「分からないことは分からない」と明示できるため、判断ミスが許されない業務に使える
高価な最新AIを使うことよりも、情報の「しまい方」を工夫することで精度を極限まで高められる
tags: ナレッジマネジメント
who_should_read: PM/プロダクトマネージャー
application_ideas: インフラ点検の「時系列台帳」化：過去数年分の点検メモを自動で構造化し、ひび割れの進行度合いを数値として正確に比較・追跡できる仕組みに活用する。
図面変更の「不整合チェック」：設計変更の経緯を構造化して保存し、最新の図面が過去の決定事項や法規制と矛盾していないかを瞬時に照合する。
工場の「熟練工ナレッジ抽出」：散乱した日報から、特定のトラブルと対処法の関係を構造的に抜き出し、誰でも検索・集計できる「生きたマニュアル」として運用する。

papers.title: NeocorRAG: Less Irrelevant Information, More Explicit Evidence, and More Effective Recall via Evidence Chains
papers.abstract: Although precise recall is a core objective in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), a critical oversight persists in the field: improvements in retrieval performance do not consistently translate to commensurate gains in downstream reasoning. To diagnose this gap, we propose the Recall Conversion Rate (RCR), a novel evaluation metric to quantify the contribution of retrieval to reasoning accuracy. Our quantitative analysis of mainstream RAG methods reveals that as Recall@5 improves, the RCR exhibits a near-linear decay. We identify the neglect of retrieval quality in these methods as the underlying cause. In contrast, approaches that focus solely on quality optimization often suffer from inferior recall performance. Both categories lack a comprehensive understanding of retrieval quality optimization, resulting in a trade-off dilemma. To address these challenges, we propose comprehensive retrieval quality optimization criteria and introduce the NeocorRAG framework. This framework achieves holistic retrieval quality optimization by systematically mining and utilizing Evidence Chains. Specifically, NeocorRAG first employs an innovative activated search algorithm to obtain a refined candidate space. Then it ensures precise evidence chain generation through constrained decoding. Finally, the retrieved set of evidence chains guides the retrieval optimization process. Evaluated on benchmarks including HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA, MuSiQue, and NQ, NeocorRAG achieves SOTA performance on both 3B and 70B parameter models, while consuming less than 20% of tokens used by comparable methods. This study presents an efficient, training-free paradigm for RAG enhancement that effectively optimizes retrieval quality while maintaining high recall. Our code is released at https://github.com/BUPT-Reasoning-Lab/NeocorRAG.
papers.headline: AIが根拠を芋づる式に見つけ、回答の正解率を劇的に高める
papers.one_liner: 膨大なデータから情報を探す際、単に関連情報を集めるだけでなく、事実同士の繋がりを「証拠の鎖（エビデンスチェーン）」として特定することで、AIの思い込み（ハルシネーション）を防ぎ、少ない文字数で正確な回答を導き出す技術です。
key_points: 「情報の量」ではなく「情報の質と繋がり」を重視し、AIが判断を誤る原因となる余計なノイズを排除できる
AIがどの情報を根拠に結論を出したのか、その「思考のプロセス」が鎖のように見える化されるため、人間が検証しやすい
追加の学習（ファインチューニング）を必要としないため、今あるAIモデルにそのまま導入して性能を底上げできる
処理に使う文字数（トークン量）を従来手法の20%以下に抑えられ、API利用コストや処理時間を大幅に削減できる
複数の文書をまたがないと答えが出ないような、複雑で高度な問い合わせに対しても高い正答率を維持できる
who_should_read: PM/プロダクトマネージャー
application_ideas: 数千ページの「施工管理指針」や「社内規定」から、特定の工法が必要な理由を関連する複数の条文を紐付けながら自動で抽出する。
工場の過去の故障事例データベースから、現在の不具合と似た事象を単に探すだけでなく、「原因→現象→対策」の連鎖を特定して復旧手順を提案する。
橋梁やトンネルの点検において、過去10年分のバラバラな点検記録から「ひび割れの進行」と「周辺環境の変化」の因果関係を証拠立てて報告書にまとめる。

papers.title: Generalizable Sparse-View 3D Reconstruction from Unconstrained Images
papers.abstract: Reconstructing 3D scenes from sparse, unposed images remains challenging under real-world conditions with varying illumination and transient occlusions. Existing methods rely on scene-specific optimization using appearance embeddings or dynamic masks, which requires extensive per-scene training and fails under sparse views. Moreover, evaluations on limited scenes raise questions about generalization. We present GenWildSplat, a feed-forward framework for sparse-view outdoor reconstruction that requires no per-scene optimization. Given unposed internet images, GenWildSplat predicts depth, camera parameters, and 3D Gaussians in a canonical space using learned geometric priors. An appearance adapter modulates appearance for target lighting conditions, while semantic segmentation handles transient objects. Through curriculum learning on synthetic and real data, GenWildSplat generalizes across diverse illumination and occlusion patterns. Evaluations on PhotoTourism and MegaScenes benchmark demonstrate state-of-the-art feed-forward rendering quality, achieving real-time inference without test-time optimization
papers.headline: 数枚のバラバラな写真から、瞬時に高精度な3D空間を再現
papers.one_liner: 撮影条件や天候がバラバラな数枚の写真から、追加の学習（微調整）なしで即座に3Dモデルを作成できます。AIがカメラの位置や光の加減、動いている通行人などを自動で判別・処理し、高品質な3D空間（3Dガウシアンスプラッティング）を構築する仕組みです。
key_points: 現場ごとのAIの再学習が不要で、写真を入れるだけで即座に3D化の結果が得られる
わずか数枚の少ない写真からでも、AIが形状を予測して3Dモデルを復元できる
写真ごとに異なる天気や明るさ、光の反射を自動で補正し、統一感のあるモデルを作る
写真に写り込んだ通行人や車などの「邪魔な動体」を賢く認識し、背景の構造物だけを抽出できる
従来は数時間かかった3D化の処理を、事前学習済みのモデルによって「待ち時間ほぼゼロ」で完了できる
who_should_read: PM/プロダクトマネージャー
application_ideas: 老朽化したインフラの過去の点検写真（バラバラな角度・年代）から、劣化状況を比較検証するための3Dモデルを自動生成する。
建設現場でスタッフがスマホで数枚撮影するだけで、その日の進捗を3D化。通行人や重機を無視して、構造物の形状だけをBIMデータと照合する。
工場の設備レイアウト検討時に、古い不完全な写真記録からでも現況を3Dで再現し、新しい機械の搬入シミュレーションに活用する。

papers.title: A Unified Framework of Hyperbolic Graph Representation Learning Methods
papers.abstract: Hyperbolic geometry has emerged as an effective latent space for representing complex networks, owing to its ability to capture hierarchical organization and heterogeneous connectivity patterns using low-dimensional embeddings. As a result, numerous hyperbolic graph representation learning methods have been proposed in recent years. However, their practical adoption and systematic comparison remain challenging, as implementations are fragmented and shared tools for reproducible and fair evaluation are lacking. In this work, we introduce a unified open-source framework for hyperbolic graph representation learning that integrates several widely used embedding methods under a common optimization interface. The novel framework enables consistent training, visualization, and evaluation of hyperbolic embeddings, and interfaces seamlessly with standard network analysis tools. Leveraging this unified setup, we conduct an experimental study of hyperbolic embedding methods on real-world networks, focusing on two canonical downstream tasks: link prediction and node classification. Beyond predictive accuracy, the study offers practical insights into the strengths and limitations of existing approaches, thereby facilitating informed method selection and fostering reproducible research in hyperbolic graph representation learning.
papers.headline: 複雑な「階層構造」をAIで正確に再現・分析できるようになる
papers.one_liner: 組織図や部品構成のような枝分かれするデータ（階層構造）を、データの質を落とさずコンパクトに処理できる最新AI手法の共通ツールキットです。バラバラだった手法を一つの共通基盤（フレームワーク）に統合し、誰でも比較や導入がしやすくなりました。
key_points: 膨大な部品の親子関係や組織のつながりを、少ない計算量（低次元）で効率よく学習できる
従来のAIでは難しかった「枝分かれが増えるほど複雑になる構造」を、歪みなく表現できる
複数の手法を一括で試せるため、自社の業務データに最適なAIモデルを素早く選定できる
データの関係性を分かりやすく視覚化（見える化）でき、AIの判断の妥当性を確認しやすい
未接続のデータのつながりを予測する精度が高まり、故障予測や工程漏れ防止に役立つ
who_should_read: PM/プロダクトマネージャー

papers.title: Contextual Agentic Memory is a Memo, Not True Memory
papers.abstract: Current agentic memory systems (vector stores, retrieval-augmented generation, scratchpads, and context-window management) do not implement memory: they implement lookup. We argue that treating lookup as memory is a category error with provable consequences for agent capability, long-term learning, and security. Retrieval generalizes by similarity to stored cases; weight-based memory generalizes by applying abstract rules to inputs never seen before. Conflating the two produces agents that accumulate notes indefinitely without developing expertise, face a provable generalization ceiling on compositionally novel tasks that no increase in context size or retrieval quality can overcome, and are structurally vulnerable to persistent memory poisoning as injected content propagates across all future sessions. Drawing on Complementary Learning Systems theory from neuroscience, we show that biological intelligence solved this problem by pairing fast hippocampal exemplar storage with slow neocortical weight consolidation, and that current AI agents implement only the first half. We formalize these limitations, address four alternative views, and close with a co-existence proposal and a call to action for system builders, benchmark designers, and the memory community.
papers.headline: AIが「検索」の限界を超え、経験を積むほど賢くなる
papers.one_liner: 今のAIは過去の情報を「メモとして見返す（検索・RAG）」だけで本当の学習をしていませんが、人間のように情報を整理して「自分の知恵（重みの更新）」に変える仕組みの必要性を説いています。
key_points: 大量の過去資料を単に「検索」するのではなく、繰り返し使う情報をAIが「暗黙知」として身につけられる

AIを長く使い込むほど「熟練工」のように洗練され、毎回情報を検索する手間やコストを削減できる

papers.title: TwinGate: Stateful Defense against Decompositional Jailbreaks in Untraceable Traffic via Asymmetric Contrastive Learning
papers.abstract: Decompositional jailbreaks pose a critical threat to large language models (LLMs) by allowing adversaries to fragment a malicious objective into a sequence of individually benign queries that collectively reconstruct prohibited content. In real-world deployments, LLMs face a continuous, untraceable stream of fully anonymized and arbitrarily interleaved requests, infiltrated by covertly distributed adversarial queries. Under this rigorous threat model, state-of-the-art defensive strategies exhibit fundamental limitations. In the absence of trustworthy user metadata, they are incapable of tracking global historical contexts, while their deployment of generative models for real-time monitoring introduces computationally prohibitive overhead. To address this, we present TwinGate, a stateful dual-encoder defense framework. TwinGate employs Asymmetric Contrastive Learning (ACL) to cluster semantically disparate but intent-matched malicious fragments in a shared latent space, while a parallel frozen encoder suppresses false positives arising from benign topical overlap. Each request requires only a single lightweight forward pass, enabling the defense to execute in parallel with the target model's prefill phase at negligible latency overhead. To evaluate our approach and advance future research, we construct a comprehensive dataset of over 3.62 million instructions spanning 8,600 distinct malicious intents. Evaluated on this large-scale corpus under a strictly causal protocol, TwinGate achieves high malicious intent recall at a remarkably low false positive rate while remaining highly robust against adaptive attacks. Furthermore, our proposal substantially outperforms stateful and stateless baselines, delivering superior throughput and reduced latency.
papers.headline: AIへの「小出しの攻撃」を瞬時に見抜いてブロックできる
papers.one_liner: 一見無害な複数の質問を組み合わせてAIから禁止情報を引き出す「分解型攻撃（小出しの不正操作）」に対し、過去の履歴を高速に照合して悪意を見抜く防御技術です。特殊な比較学習（非対称対照学習）を用いることで、ユーザーを待たせることなく高い精度で安全性を確保します。
key_points: バラバラに送られてくる「一見無害な質問」の裏に隠された、本当の悪意ある狙いを見抜けます。
誰が送ったか特定できない匿名の通信環境でも、過去の文脈を高速にたどって危険を察知できます。
AIが回答を準備する裏側でチェックを行うため、ユーザーの待ち時間がほぼ増えません。
普通の会話を誤って「攻撃」と判断して止めてしまう間違い（誤検知）を極限まで抑えています。
360万件以上の膨大なデータでテスト済みであり、実際の運用に耐えうる高い信頼性が証明されています。
who_should_read: PM/プロダクトマネージャー
application_ideas: 社内の設計BIMデータへの不正アクセス対策。複数の社員アカウントから断片的な情報を引き出し、機密設計を復元しようとする動きを「一連の攻撃」として検知する。

papers.title: Position-Aware Drafting for Inference Acceleration in LLM-Based Generative List-Wise Recommendation
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based generative list-wise recommendation has advanced rapidly, but decoding remains sequential and thus latency-prone. To accelerate inference without changing the target distribution, speculative decoding (SD) uses a small draft model to propose several next tokens at once and a target LLM to verify and accept the longest prefix, skipping multiple steps per round. In generative recommendation, however, each item is represented by multiple semantic-ID tokens, often with separators, and current drafts typically treat these tokens uniformly. This overlooks two practical facts: (i) a token's semantics depend on its within-item slot, and (ii) uncertainty tends to increase with speculation depth. Without modeling these effects, SD's speedups can be limited. We introduce PAD-Rec, Position-Aware Drafting for generative Recommendation, a lightweight module that augments the draft model with two complementary signals. Item position embeddings explicitly encode the within-item slot of each token, strengthening structural awareness. Step position embeddings encode the draft step, allowing the model to adapt to depth-dependent uncertainty and improve proposal quality. To harmonize these signals with base features, we add simple gates: a learnable coefficient for item slots and a context-driven gate for draft steps. The module is trainable, easy to integrate with standard draft models, and adds negligible inference overhead. Extensive experiments on four real-world datasets show up to 3.1x wall-clock speedup and about 5% average wall-clock speedup gain over strong SD baselines, while largely preserving recommendation quality.
papers.headline: おすすめリスト作成AIの待ち時間を最大1/3に短縮できる
papers.one_liner: 大規模AIによる「おすすめリスト作成」を、精度を落とさずに最大3倍高速化する技術です。AIに「リストの何番目の情報を書いているか」という位置情報を意識させることで、下書き（ドラフトモデル）の精度を高め、最終的な回答生成（推論）の効率を劇的に向上させます。
key_points: AIの応答待ち時間が大幅に減り、ユーザーへの提案スピードが劇的に向上します。

papers.title: HAVEN: Hybrid Automated Verification ENgine for UVM Testbench Synthesis with LLMs
papers.abstract: Integrated Circuit (IC) verification consumes nearly 70% of the IC development cycle, and recent research leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) to automatically generate testbenches and reduce verification overhead. However, LLMs have difficulty generating testbenches correctly. Unlike high-level programming languages, Hardware Description Languages (HDLs) are extremely rare in LLMs training data, leading LLMs to produce incorrect code. To overcome challenges when using LLMs to generate Universal Verification Methodology (UVM) testbenches and sequences, wepropose HAVEN (Hybrid Automated Verification ENgine) to prevent LLMs from writing HDL directly. For UVM testbench generation, HAVEN utilizes LLM agents to analyze design specifications to produce a structured architectural plan. The HAVEN Template Engine then combines with predefined and protocol-specific templates to generate all UVM components with correct bus-handshake timing. For UVM sequence generation, HAVEN introduces a Protocol-Aware Sequence Domain-Specific Language (DSL) that decomposes sequences into fine-grained step types. A set of predefined DSL patterns first establishes sequences that achieve a high coverage rate without LLM involvement. HAVEN continues to improve the coverage rate by iteratively leveraging LLM agents to analyze coverage gap reports and compose additional targeted DSL sequences. Unlike previous works, HAVEN is the first system that utilizes pre-defined, protocol-specific Jinja2 templates to generate all UVM components and UVM sequences using our proposed Protocol-Aware DSL and rule-based code generator. Our experimental results on 19 open-source IP designs spanning three interface protocols (Direct, Wishbone, AXI4-Lite) show that HAVEN achieves 100% compilation success, 90.6% code coverage, and 87.9% functional coverage on average, and is SOTA among LLM-assisted testbench generation systems.
papers.headline: 半導体設計のテスト工程をAIで自動化、動くコードを100%生成
papers.one_liner: 専門知識が必要な半導体テストにおいて、AIが設計書を読み解き、あらかじめ用意された「正しい型（テンプレート）」に当てはめることで、AIの思い込み（ハルシネーション）を防ぎつつ、動く検証コードを確実に自動作成します。
key_points: AIが直接難しいプログラムを書かない仕組みにより、プログラムの動作エラー（コンパイル失敗）をゼロにできる

papers.title: RIHA: Report-Image Hierarchical Alignment for Radiology Report Generation
papers.abstract: Radiology report generation (RRG) has emerged as a promising approach to alleviate radiologists' workload and reduce human errors by automatically generating diagnostic reports from medical images. A key challenge in RRG is achieving fine-grained alignment between complex visual features and the hierarchical structure of long-form radiology reports. Although recent methods have improved image-text representation learning, they often treat reports as flat sequences, overlooking their structured sections and semantic hierarchies. This simplification hinders precise cross-modal alignment and weakens RRG accuracy. To address this challenge, we propose RIHA (Report-Image Hierarchical Alignment Transformer), a novel end-to-end framework that performs multi-level alignment between radiological images and their corresponding reports across paragraph, sentence, and word levels. This hierarchical alignment enables more precise cross-modal mapping, essential for capturing the nuanced semantics embedded in clinical narratives. Specifically, RIHA introduces a Visual Feature Pyramid (VFP) to extract multi-scale visual features and a Text Feature Pyramid (TFP) to represent multi-granularity textual structures. These components are integrated through a Cross-modal Hierarchical Alignment (CHA) module, leveraging optimal transport to effectively align visual and textual features across various levels. Furthermore, we incorporate Relative Positional Encoding (RPE) into the decoder to model spatial and semantic relationships among tokens, enhancing the token-level alignment between visual features and generated text. Extensive experiments on two benchmark chest X-ray datasets, IU-Xray and MIMIC-CXR, demonstrate that RIHA outperforms existing state-of-the-art models in both natural language generation and clinical efficacy metrics.
papers.headline: レントゲン画像から「正確で漏れのない」診断書をAIが自動作成
papers.one_liner: 画像の特徴とレポートの文章構造（段落・文章・単語）を階層的にひも付ける（階層的アライメント）ことで、医療画像の読影レポートを、医師が書くような正確な構成で自動生成する技術です。
key_points: 画像内の細かい特徴と、文章内の単語・文章・段落の各レベルを対応させるため、情報の食い違いが起きにくい

papers.title: EdgeLPR: On the Deep Neural Network trade-off between Precision and Performance in LiDAR Place Recognition
papers.abstract: Place recognition is essential for long-term autonomous navigation, enabling loop closure and consistent mapping. Although deep learning has improved performance, deploying such models on resource-constrained platforms remains challenging. This work explores efficient LiDAR-based place recognition for EdgeAI by leveraging Bird's Eye View representations to enable lightweight image-based networks. We benchmark representative architectures without aggregation heads using a unified descriptor scheme based on global pooling and linear projection, and evaluate performance under FP32, FP16, and INT8 quantization. Experiments reveal trade-offs between accuracy, robustness, and efficiency: FP16 matches FP32 with lower cost, while INT8 introduces architecture-dependent degradation. Overall, the presented results are a strong basis for future research on 'use-case'-aware quantisation of Neural Networks for Edge deployment.
papers.headline: 3Dスキャンの「場所の特定」を小型AIで実現、点検を自動化
papers.one_liner: 3Dレーザー（LiDAR）の点群データを真上から見た図（鳥瞰図）に変換して処理することで、小型の現場端末でも「以前来た場所か」を正確かつ高速に判定（場所認識）できるようになります。

papers.title: DataClaw: A Process-Oriented Agent Benchmark for Exploratory Real-World Data Analysis
papers.abstract: Evaluating autonomous data analysis agents requires testing their ability to perform exploratory analysis in underexplored data environments. However, many existing benchmarks emphasize final answer accuracy in prior-guided data settings and provide limited support for reasoning process evaluation. We introduce DataClaw, a process-oriented benchmark for exploratory real-world data analysis. DataClaw contains approximately 2.06 million real-world records across enterprise, industry and policy domains, with native data noise preserved. It further includes 492 cross-domain tasks derived from think-tank consulting scenarios, each annotated with intermediate milestones for process-level evaluation. These annotations allow DataClaw to measure how far an agent progresses and where its reasoning breaks down. Experiments with eight advanced LLMs show that current agents remain far from reliable in this setting, with seven models achieving below 50% overall accuracy. Process analysis further reveals partial progress hidden behind wrong answers and distinct exploration strategies across models. Overall, DataClaw provides a less data constrained diagnostic testbed for probing the capability boundaries of autonomous data-analysis agents.
papers.headline: AIの「考え方の癖」を可視化し、泥臭いデータ分析を任せられる
papers.one_liner: ノイズの多い生の業務データを使って、AIが結論に至るまでの「推論のステップ」を細かく採点し、AIの思い込み（ハルシネーション）や分析の弱点を浮き彫りにする評価手法です。
key_points: 加工されていない「汚れた生データ」で、AIがどこまで実務に耐えるか検証できる

企業の経営判断や複雑な政策調査など、高度な専門知識が必要な場面でのAIの実力が見える
最新のAIでも正答率が5割を切るような「現実的な難問」で、AIの限界を正しく把握できる
AIが分析を諦めたり間違えたりする具体的なポイントを特定し、ツール改善に繋げられる
who_should_read: PM/プロダクトマネージャー
